about: 21st.dev is the largest React component registry for AI applications, used by 2M developers We provide the building blocks to create agent-powered apps: UI components, agent templates.

name: Palus Finance
line: Your startup's financial advisor
about: After a fundraise, you want to focus 100% on scaling your company, but suddenly there's a mountain of finance and ops decisions you need to figure out. Though these tasks feel like distractions, making the wrong decisions here can literally kill your company. Palus is your startup's financial advisor. We help you with the decisions that come with scaling: where to store your cash, how to think about runway, and how to optimize your company’s finance/ops setup.

name: Tepali
line: AI EMR for medical aesthetics & wellness
about: Tepali is the AI EMR for medspas & wellness clinics. Front desk, charting, point of sale, and marketing in one system, with an AI employee that books new leads, charts every appointment, and brings past clients back.

name: Cumulus Labs
line: The Fastest Multimodal Inference OS
about: Cumulus Labs lets engineering teams ship AI in production without needing a dedicated ML platform team. Right now, companies building AI products are forced to stitch together separate vendors for routing, observability, evaluation, fine-tuning, and inference. This fragmented approach is brittle, expensive, and is a common reason enterprises fail with AI. We replace that entire stack with a single unified platform.

name: Verdex
line: AI Verification for Insurance
about: Verdex is an AI insurance adjuster. We use data streams like satellite imagery to verify claims, allowing insurers to process it immediately and save billions of dollars. We are currently helping insure over 11% of all American farmland.

name: AutoSitu
line: The AI operating system for the built world
about: At AutoSitu, we’re building the AI operating system for the built world—coordinated AI agents that work across development, design, review, and construction. Our agents analyze complex plans, requirements, and project documentation in minutes—surfacing critical issues, doing the heavy lifting, and escalating the decisions that require human expertise.

name: Zatanna
line: Building the infrastructure for AI to interact with software
about: Zatanna is building the infrastructure for AI to interact with software. AI agents are increasingly capable of performing work that was previously done by humans, but they're still constrained by software interfaces designed for people. Today, agents rely heavily on clicking buttons, navigating pages, and interacting with UIs to get things done. At Zatanna, we're changing that by reverse engineering applications to turn their underlying workflows and actions into reliable, read-and-write APIs, regardless of whether those applications offer APIs themselves.

name: MouseCat
line: AI to fight financial crime
about: MouseCat enables companies to detect suspicious activity, automate investigations, and act before the money leaves. We work with Fortune 500 companies and startups to deploy real-time models and AI agents that reduce fraud, compliance incidents, and friction for good customers.

name: Skillsync
line: Search your agent session history
about: Skillsync makes your agent session history searchable. Both for you and your coding agents. It searches all your sessions before each prompt and hands your agent what you already figured out. It gives you one place for everything your agents have ever done. Move a full session between Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and any other agent with nothing lost, including the entire conversation, the model's reasoning, and every tool call, not just a summary, so the next agent picks up like it was there the whole time.

name: RoboDock
line: Robots that run autonomous depots for autonomous fleets.
about: RoboDock builds robots that automate depot operations, like charging and vehicle checks, for electric and autonomous vehicle fleets. We turn fleet depots from manual sites into self-running systems that lower operational costs and increase vehicle uptime.

name: Scheduling Wizard
line: Logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations
about: Scheduling Wizard is building the logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations. Hospitals still rely on manual workflows to manage staffing, patient flow, and core operations, contributing to $760B in annual inefficiency. 20 departments across 16 hospitals already outsource their physician scheduling to us, powered by our internal Scheduling Programming Language and AI-driven workflows. We work with Mass General, Johns Hopkins, UT Southwestern, UCSF, and many others.

name: Luel
line: Turning everyday words and actions into usable training data.
about: Luel is a sourcing and licensing platform for rights-cleared multimodal training data at scale. We work with frontier AI teams to provide high-quality bespoke data collections and off-the-shelf datasets.

name: Aemon
line: The Forward-Deployed AI Research Engineer
about: Aemon is the first autonomous research engineer that delivers state-of-the-art solutions to your engineering problems. It generates, tests, and evolves thousands of approaches at machine speed to discover optimal solutions beyond what human experts can find. Aemon already set a new world record on an NP-hard math optimization problem with <$10 of compute, beating the previous record set by Google DeepMind in 2025. Ray and Richard (twin brothers) dropped out of UWaterloo and UIUC to build Aemon. They published at top AI conferences like ICLR and EMNLP before turning 20.

name: Ashr
line: Enterprise post-training, monitoring, and continual learning platform
about: Ashr Manifold is a self-contained model training, hosting, observability, and continual learning platform for purpose-built open-weight models. Startups can use Manifold to post-train and manage fleets of continuously improving open-weight models without having a dedicated research team or infrastructure. Ultimately, this reduces operating costs and allows a greater degree of control over proprietary company knowledge.

name: CodeWisp
line: Anyone can create real games with AI
about: CodeWisp lets anyone build and publish web games using plain-English prompts. Traditional game development requires learning complex engines, managing assets and code, and following rigid workflows, making it slow and inaccessible for most people. With CodeWisp, users describe the game they want. CodeWisp generates the game’s code, structure, and assets, and users can refine it with follow-up prompts. This makes it possible to go from idea to a playable web game in minutes, without prior game-development experience.

name: OctaPulse
line: OctaPulse builds computer vision and robotics for fish farms and…
about: OctaPulse is building the robotics layer for seafood production. Aquaculture is the fastest-growing food sector and already produces more seafood than commercial fishing, yet the people who breed and process fish still make thousands of decisions a day with almost no data about the fish in front of them, and much of the most important work is still done by hand, one fish at a time. We put cameras where fish are already handled, turn every image into measurements, and give farms and plants the tools to act on them.

name: Beyond Reach Labs
line: Space solar arrays that grow to the size of a football field in orbit
about: At Beyond Reach Labs we are building solar panels for Space that grow from the size of a dining table to a football field in orbit. Mitch and Pele met 13 years ago as freshmen at UPenn studying mechanical engineering. Mitch recently got his PhD at Carnegie Mellon working with NASA on kilometer-scale deployable structures, and Pele spent seven years at SpaceX leading Dragon parachute engineering, safely returning astronauts from space.

name: Milliray
line: Technology to detect and track small drones
about: We make radars that can see small drones. As drones evolve faster than air defenses, detection has fallen behind. Even $50 drones now present a major threat to airports, critical infrastructure, and front-line defense. We solve this by building high-frequency radar systems, designed from the ground up to detect even the most challenging low-signature targets. This allows us to identify and track nano drones like no other solution, letting you know what's truly in your airspace.

name: RamAIn
line: RamAIn - AI Employees with a computer to perform business tasks just…
about: RamAIn Employees join your team just like a human. Teach them to work across systems just like a new hire and watch them work autonomously to do the work 24/7.

name: Moritz
line: Global AI-native law firm handling legal work with same-day turnaround
about: Moritz is a global AI-native law firm that will handles legal work with same day turnaround. Our lawyers have closed $ 3bn in deals with an average turnaround of 4-hours. No other law firm offers this kind of speed for complex deals. We're backed by YC, 20VC and the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, Instacart, Reddit, Superhuman, Producthunt, HuggingFace and 15 other unicorn founders.

name: Salus
line: Guardrails to validate your agent's actions before they execute
about: Your agent processed a refund without looking up the order ID, costing you thousands. You only found out three hours later from a support ticket. Evals, output scoring, and observability can reduce the likelihood of mistakes like these occurring - but there's no solution that inspects and prevents an action as it’s about to execute. Salus does that. We’ve built an API that wraps around your agent and checks its actions at run time, blocking incorrect ones and providing immediate feedback to guide retries.

name: EigenPal
line: AI Document Workflows for Enterprises
about: EigenPal.com automates your document processing workflows with AI. KYC docs, invoices, claims, shipping forms, contracts, receipts, loan docs - we automate that. Works on messy scans, handwritten forms, third-party docs. Powerful workflow builder and team functionality. On-prem ready or use our cloud.

name: Sparkles
line: Make everyone on your team an engineer
about: Sparkles gives your whole team coding agents that work on your real codebase. Connect your GitHub repos once, and anyone on the team can start a run from the web app or by @mentioning Sparkles in Slack. Pick Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode and describe the change in plain language. The agent works in an isolated cloud sandbox with your tools already plugged in, like Linear, Sentry, Notion and Figma. You can watch every command and file edit live and jump in mid-run. Every run ends as a GitHub pull request.

name: Fern
line: RL environments for robotics companies
about: Fern build high fidelity simulations for robotics, specifically focused on manipulation tasks. Customers have run over 900k simulation rollouts for RL and evaluations, and have verified that the simulation fidelity is high enough such that the real to sim and sim to real gap is very small.

name: Perfectly
line: The AI-native Recruiting OS
about: Perfectly is the first AI-native Recruiting OS. Since starting YC, we’re already helping top startups like Giga, Corgi, LlamaIndex, Porter, and dozens more hire faster. We’re seeing: -> 4× faster hiring -> 10× candidate volume -> 2× higher interview pass rates Behind the scenes, it’s even more impressive: -> 20x higher recruiting efficiency: from 20 hours to 1 hour -> 250% higher candidate interview retention We automate the entire recruiting function: sourcing, outreach, screening, and qualification. Interview ready candidates just show up in Slack.

name: Orthogonal
line: Agentic Payments for APIs
about: APIs weren't built for agents. Orthogonal fixes that. We enable agentic payments so any agent can instantly discover, access, and pay for hundreds of APIs. No subscriptions, no sales calls, just pay per use. API providers list once and get paid every time an agent calls their API.

name: Q2Q
line: We help private equity teams find acquisition targets faster
about: Q2Q is the AI-native outbound engine for deal sourcing. Tell us the types of companies you want to buy, and we'll get qualified meetings booked for you. You can think of Q2Q as your personal team of AI interns. You give us your buying criteria, and we'll go out and find companies, write personalized emails, and get first calls booked with business owners for you. As the human in the loop, you'll approve messages before we send. Q2Q handles the sourcing work so you can focus on evaluating great deals.

name: Ventura
line: AI Workforce for Distributors and Manufacturers
about: Ventura builds the AI workforce for distributors and manufacturers, starting with quoting and order entry. It plugs into your existing ERP, follows your SOPs, and learns your team's tribal knowledge - getting smarter with every completed task.

name: Drafted
line: Design your home instantly with AI
about: Drafted is building multimodal generative models for residential architecture and spatial design. The product allows users to design homes by combining sketches and direct spatial input to generate coherent floor plans and elevations that can be explored in both 2D and 3D. Users can define footprints, lot boundaries, room placement, relationships, room programs, and square footage constraints that persist across generations and iterative design exploration, then export CAD, PDF, and other files into the rest of the home design and construction process.

name: Terranox AI
line: The first AI-powered uranium discovery company
about: Terranox is the first vertically integrated AI-powered uranium exploration company. We find high-grade uranium deposits in North America using AI trained on 70+ years of exploration outcomes. Our mission is to find the fuel we need to power the next century with nuclear energy.

name: Sponge
line: Financial infrastructure for the agent economy
about: Sponge is the easiest way for agents to hold and spend money, and for businesses to sell directly to them. For agents: Sponge lets agents hold funds and transact autonomously with other agents and businesses using bank accounts, cards, and crypto. Agents can autonomously purchase services such as email, browser use, and premium data without human involvement. For businesses: Sponge makes it easy to onboard and accept payments from agents without human interaction. Businesses can sell their services directly to agents with a few clicks, no code changes required.

name: Mango Medical
line: Foundation models for planning orthopedic surgery
about: Mango Medical builds agentic surgical planning AI for orthopedic surgery. We deliver surgeon-ready plans in minutes instead of days. 8-figure LOI from a top orthopedic company. Pursuing FDA 510(k) clearance. We're building a future where every surgery follows a personalized plan.

name: Rapidfolio
line: AI-native back-office for banks and fintechs
about: Rapidfolio helps banks and fintechs fully automate back-office workflows like fraud investigations, KYB/KYC and loan underwriting, with accuracy and auditability. Built by fintech founders and operators, Rapidfolio is on a mission to ensure banks and fintechs scale their customer base without adding another back-office head count.

name: Confluence Labs
line: AI models that learn from experience
about: While modern AI excels in any area you can collect a lot of data for, it struggles in areas where data is sparse or costly to attain. Designing new molecules, discovering new physics, and engineering new materials are all domains where collecting data is extremely costly. We dream of a world where AI accelerates research in all of these domains and creates a more abundant future for humanity, but the current technology is not there. That’s why we started Confluence Labs.

name: Opalite Health
line: Helping Healthcare Providers Speak Any Language
about: Opalite makes it easy for healthcare providers to communicate with non-English speaking patients. We’re built to work inside existing clinical workflows, so providers can communicate in real time without waiting for an interpreter or delaying care. Opalite is available instantly, 24/7, and replaces traditional interpretation services with software that’s more reliable and saves millions of dollars per year. We've built a voice AI system that is the safest, most compliant, and most accurate medical interpreter in the world.

name: Compresr
line: LLM context compression for better accuracy
about: Compresr provides an API that compresses LLM context without losing what matters. It’s a drop-in for agents and RAG that cuts token costs and improves accuracy.

name: IncidentFox
line: AI SRE agent that triages, coordinates, and fixes production incidents
about: AI SRE agents that automatically learn each customer’s system so they work just like an in-house engineer.

name: Unisson
line: AI agents that automate B2B software implementation
about: Unisson is building trusted AI subject-matter experts for teams that are responsible for customer deployments (technical customer success, implementation, sales engineering). Within 20 minutes, our agents learn to use any product and can be used by teams in Slack, text, or email. Our agents gather requirements and context from existing tools enabling them to handle complex tasks like customer health audits, onboarding, product administration, and custom integrations. With Unisson, customer-facing teams have 24/7 access to an AI SME, allowing them to scale and save thousands of hours.

name: Stilta
line: Agentic AI for intellectual property
about: Stilta builds agentic AI software for intellectual property, starting with patent litigation. Whether challenging or enforcing a patent, leading IP law firms and in-house IP teams use Stilta for source-backed, auditable analysis. Innovation drives the world's most important breakthroughs, but the tools that protect it haven't kept pace. Patent attorneys do high-stakes work with a process still built on manual document review and disconnected point solutions.

name: Instinct
line: Trade with superhuman instinct
about: Capital allocation is becoming a more important part of individual economic life. Finance is moving toward a global, onchain, 24/7 future with thousands of markets trading at once. The asset management industry is built around the scarcity of financial expertise and the cost of organizing people around capital. Institutions cover global markets by employing analysts, researchers, and quants around the clock. AI turns this organizational capacity into software. Instinct is building the harness for this transition.

name: Proximitty
line: AI operating system for commercial loans
about: Proximitty is the AI operating system for commercial loans - we build regulator-grade AI agents that ingest and parse documents, spread financials, automate loan operations and track covenants. We help FDIC-insured banks and fintechs underwrite faster and scale their loan books without scaling costs.

name: Cajal
line: Scaling formal verification to accelerate scientific discovery
about: Cajal (YC W26) is massively scaling formal verification to accelerate scientific discovery. We deploy superhuman AI mathematicians to high-impact applied domains, starting with quantum computing and finance. We do this with Lean - a framework that allows us to formally verify any mathematical statement, grounding AI in truth and validating the tools discovered by our systems.

name: Overshoot
line: We optimize inference stacks for teams
about: Overshoot makes AI models run faster and cheaper on your hardware. Serving engines like vLLM and SGLang were designed for the average workload. This results in most deployments being extremely inefficient, especially around throughput (hence cost). We profile your workload on your hardware, then build a custom deployment image tuned to the metrics you care about, within the quality limits you set. You only pay if we meet the performance target we agree on.

name: Terminal Use
line: AI-native transformation for operations-heavy companies
about: AI pilots are everywhere. Few organizations can point to a department that actually runs AI-first. Terminal Use changes that. We help operations teams rebuild how work gets done, end to end. We begin with one critical process, map how it runs today and where it breaks, then redesign the workflow around AI agents, existing systems, and people at the right control points. The result is a working AI-first process, measurable operational change, and a blueprint for transforming the broader department.

name: Laurence
line: Agents that run your Amazon ads
about: Advertising today is like trading in the 1980s pits: archaic, manual, and iterative guesswork. Humans update bids and keywords with noisy, delayed data using simple if-else rules that both break at scale and ignore stochasticity. Laurence advertises like modern hedge funds trade markets, driving a 15-40% improvement in net profit for Amazon brands within a month of onboarding.

name: Parameter
line: AI pentesting, that works!
about: Parameter builds AI agents that run continuous penetration tests against your apps and infrastructure. Instead of a once-a-year penetration test, Parameter's agents works 24/7 to find and verify critical vulnerabilities so you can prevent them before attackers. Formerly Hex Security

name: Pax Historia
line: The first AI-powered worldbuilding and gameplay platform
about: Pax Historia is an AI powered sandbox game where players create and upload whatever worlds they can imagine for others to play. What if Rome never fell? What if aliens invaded Earth? What if you were a college dropout creating a tech startup? The ability to create, edit, and copy custom maps, actors, historical context, and more means that users can play nearly any scenario they can imagine. We've organically built a passionate fanbase of tens of thousands of daily active players and we're excited to expand on this early start.

name: Rhizome AI
line: Agent Platform for Life Sciences
about: It takes 500,000 days of office work to bring a drug to market. We want to make it 5. To get there, we need agents doing most of the work. Today, our research agent is the best way to know what the FDA thinks. Users ask a question and get an answer backed by up to 1,000 documents, where each statement has a citation. It’s the best because we have the best retrieval engine. We’ve tuned it on our life science-specific dataset, and we find what others miss. As more teams use Rhizome, we gain more data on what regulatory professionals actually need, which makes retrieval even better.
where: New York City, NY, USA; Remote

name: Prana
line: An AI primary care doctor in your pocket
about: Prana replaces the reactive, 15-minute annual physical with continuous, proactive care. We connect to your medical records and wearables to watch for "clinical drift," catching subtle declines in health that human doctors miss between visits. Most AI health apps are just chatbots. Prana is a full-stack medical provider. Our AI acts as a always-on physician that watches your data, explains your labs, and manages your prescriptions. Safety & Scale: We automate 90% of the "grunt work" (history taking, logistics, triage) so our human doctors can focus purely on high-leverage decisions.

name: Cardboard
line: AI video editor (raw footage into finished videos)
about: Cardboard (cardboard.ai) is an AI video editor that turns raw footage into finished videos, from social clips and highlight reels to product demos, launch videos and event recaps. Describe the video you want, and Cardboard turns your clips, photos, recordings or a link into an edit you can watch, change and export, in the browser, in the Mac app, or right inside ChatGPT and Claude. It pulls out the best moments, removes pauses and filler words, adds captions, titles, music and B-roll, and reframes for Reels, Shorts and TikTok.

name: Jinba
line: Automate enterprise workflows through chat
about: Jinba lets enterprise teams vibe-code AI workflows instead of drag and drop. Describe what you need in plain language, and your whole company can start using it immediately. No engineers required. Enterprise-grade permissions, audit logging, and on-prem deployment built in. We serve 40,000 enterprise users at major financial institutions. Build something your colleagues want.

name: Seeing Systems
line: Modular AI-Commanded Drones for Defence
about: We engineer inexpensive, autonomous strike drones designed to operate in the most contested combat environments on Earth! By combining true hardware modularity with an agentic control system that lowers cognitive load on operators, we enable faster upgrades, broader adoption, and more than 2x reduction in lifecycle cost. Our customers and partners include the UK Royal Marine Commandos, several other units in the UK, and 4 other NATO forces, and we are currently shipping prototypes for iterative feedback. Think of us as Anduril, but with worse weather, and better banter.

name: Synthetic Sciences
line: Infrastructure for Autonomous Science
about: Synthetic Sciences is a research lab building infrastructure for scientific superintelligence. Empirical science is bottlenecked by verification that is slow, expensive, and imperfect. We work on tooling, evals, training environments, algorithms, and labs that make autonomous science possible.

name: Visibl Semiconductors
line: Custom silicon for power electronics
about: Visibl Semiconductors makes custom silicon accessible to hardware companies, starting with power electronics. We are an AI-native custom-silicon design partner that cuts ASIC development cost and timeline on mature nodes, helping teams deliver better performance and lower BOM cost. We work with data-center and AI-infrastructure power, motor drives, industrial automation and robotics, industrial power supplies and conversion, battery systems and e-mobility powertrains, EV charging, solar, energy storage, grid power, HVAC, heat pumps, and appliances.

name: Patientdesk.ai
line: AI front & back office agent for dental practices
about: Patientdesk is an AI bookings system that helps healthcare practices make more money. We do this by handling bookings, payments, and insurance to fill up a provider's calendar with high value appointments.

name: Assemble
line: Autonomous IT Delivery
about: Assemble accelerates IT teams by performing development work inside core enterprise systems like ERP, CRM, and HRIS. Our agents help IT teams scope dependencies, build logic, and validate changes across your systems.

name: Chamber
line: The AIOps Agent for ML Teams
about: Chamber puts your AI infrastructure on autopilot, and saves your machine learning engineers hours of manual effort. Our agents continually monitor, detects failures, provide root-cause analysis, resolve issues, and optimize AI workloads and scale across clouds. It operates like an autonomous infrastructure team, helping save your research and engineers hours each day, and debugging workload performance issues. Your ML teams move faster, infra waste drops, and GPU bottlenecks disappear.

name: End Close
line: AI powered reconciliation for high-volume payments companies
about: End Close builds automatic reconciliation for payments companies like fintechs, marketplaces, banks and payroll companies. Reconciliation helps companies track every dollar and resolve every exception, ensuring they have no money loss, can report audit ready financials, and stay compliant. Sean (CEO) spent the last 6 years building the reconciliation org at Modern Treasury (S18), processing a trillion dollars in payments across 40 banks with 99.995% automation. Fast growing companies like Modern Treasury are forced to build a solution in-house or buy a legacy solution.

name: Fenrock AI
line: AI agents for banks
about: We're building the Legora for traditional financial services, working closely with US bank CEOs to transform their businesses.

name: Maywood
line: The first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7
about: Maywood is the first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7, working across your network, pipeline, and active processes, running constantly in the background and surfacing things you'd otherwise miss. It tracks relationships and sector context to flag when a target is gearing up for a process (and drafts the outreach in your voice), watches network activity across LinkedIn, news, and conference follow-ups, and surfaces where active processes stand, including what's at risk since you last looked.

name: Revion
line: Intelligence for Automotive Operations
about: Revion is building the operating system for Automotive Retail. Our first product helps Technicians automate administrative work, which drains 30-40% of their day. With Revion, Auto Retailers can service more vehicles and drive more high-margin Revenue.

name: Traverse
line: On a mission to keep the future in human hands.
about: Humans control the future because we are the most intelligent species on Earth. We believe AI will soon change that, and that our control is at risk. As a research lab, we study AI alignment and model psychology to ensure these systems have our best interests at heart. We post-train models for companies on the same principle, so that the models they rely on are their own and act in their interest. We are a small team of researchers and engineers, and we’re hiring!

name: SideKit
line: Consumer app studio.
about: SideKit is a consumer app studio that makes Island, a different kind of screen time app.

name: 9 Mothers
line: Counter Drone Systems. $1.6m sales. We delivered for the DoW.
about: We have sold $1.6m of systems to the DoW. Multiple systems delivered to the DoW. Our first product - EDDA - is a counter drone system - small, low power, low cost fully autonomous-capable. It's designed to be used on vehicles, bases, or carried - to stop group 1 suicide drones. We have multiple contracts, sales, etc. We have 3 more products with demand in various stages of development. More details at https://9mothers.com

name: Valence
line: Unified prediction markets trading platform
about: Valence is a unified trading platform for prediction markets. We provide infrastructure to aggregate and execute contracts across Kalshi, Polymarket, and other platforms, surface arbitrage and mispricing opportunities in real time, and give systematic traders the API and backtesting tools they need to build and execute data-driven strategies on anything.

name: Reframe
line: AI-native, hardware procurement marketplace
about: Reframe is the only AI-native marketplace for hardware teams to procure both COTS and custom manufactured components. We have access to trusted suppliers that have made parts for the most reliable hardware products that people use today (iPhones, Teslas, and more). We use Agents to automate end-to-end procurement so that hardware teams can scale while remaining lean.

name: Congruent
line: AI native radars for self-driving cars
about: At Congruent, we build radars for end-to-end autonomous systems. The most advanced autonomous systems are trained as a single neural network from raw sensor data to navigation actions. For a sensor to be included in these pipelines sensor stacks requires two key properties: access to raw sensor data and a high-fidelity sensor simulator. Current automotive radars have neither, they output heavily processed point clouds and no raw radar simulator exists for driving scenes.

name: InventoryQuant
line: We automate the inventory process in insurance
about: We automate inventory and contents processing for insurance and insurance-adjacent industries, including public adjusters, restoration contents, and insurance companies. We also handle various inventory and estimate adjacent processes that cost many billions of dollars a year and thousands of years of man hours.

name: Wingman Law
line: AI-native personal injury law firm
about: Wingman Law is an AI-native personal injury law firm. Attorneys lead a team of AI agents to recover compensation for people injured in accidents. We are solving the human bottle neck in personal injury.

name: Emdash
line: One app for all your coding agents
about: Emdash brings Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents into one app. Run agents in parallel on your own infrastructure, Emdash Cloud or locally. Start tasks from Slack, Linear or GitHub, and let agents keep working after you close your laptop. Access sessions from web, desktop or mobile. Share environments, skills, MCP servers and secrets across your team, with centralized access and spend controls. Bring your existing AI subscriptions and cloud commitments. No lock-in.

name: Ressl AI
line: Train, eval and build autonomous agents
about: Ressl AI helps teams bridge the gap from prototype to production by providing the platform needed to train, benchmark, and deploy autonomous agents that actually work in real-world business systems.

name: Robby
line: AI agents that grow revenue for home services businesses
about: Robby is an AI growth engine for home services businesses that uncovers revenue opportunities and collects additional data from every technician visit. Our AI combines customer and third party data to generate dozens of new leads every day, and then arms the technicians with talking points to increase close rates, giving GMs a single command center to manage and drive revenue. We have several paying customers that are each uncovering 6 figures in additional revenue opportunities every week. On our first day of launch, we helped close $40k in new business within an hour.

name: Sitefire
line: Marketing suite for the agentic web
about: Sitefire (YC W26) helps brands market their products to agents. They create content and tools that get their products discovered and used by AI agents (ChatGPT, OpenClaw). Sitefire identifies which content drives AI visibility, and automatically creates it. The teams using Sitefire execute on-page and off-page actions to deliver measurable top-line growth.

name: Forum
line: The first exchange to trade on attention.
about: Forum is building the first exchange to trade on cultural attention. We create indices from search, social, and streaming data to measure what the world cares about, enabling users to go long or short on changes in relevance. Attention is the primary driver of business success in the digital age, but it has never been directly tradable. Forum introduces attention as a new asset class for managing cultural and demand risk.

name: Human Archive
line: Physical AI data lab
about: Human Archive (YC W26) is building the data and deployments infrastructure for physical AI. We design hardware, deploy cameras and sensors globally, and train models that help AI better understand how humans interact with the physical world. Leading frontier AI labs trust us for their video, sensor, robot deployment, image, and audio datasets. We have offices in SF, China, and India and are researchers from NYU GRAIL, UPenn GRASP, UC Berkeley, Stanford, Johns Hopkins Robotics, and national robotics champions. To get data, please reach out to raj@humanarchive.ai

name: Samora AI
line: Multilingual voice agents that outperform humans
about: Samora runs multilingual voice operations for organizations with high-volume calling without requiring engineering teams, call centers, or AI expertise. Many important tasks still depend on phone calls, including customer support, outreach, follow-ups, screening, and intake. But voice AI often fails in production because real callers interrupt, go off-script, switch languages mid-sentence, and speak in local dialects. Teams also worry about safety and compliance, especially when an agent can accidentally make the wrong promise.

name: Caretta
line: Realtime AI for Sales Calls
about: Caretta is a Sales Intelligence for revenue teams. It joins reps in live calls, helping them handle information requests, questions, and objections in real time. Caretta lives in Slack to join the team conversation. Caretta gets smarter automatically: every call expands its knowledge base and objection library, turning conversations into compounding organizational advantage.

name: Oximy
line: Take command of the AI your company already runs on.
about: Oximy is one platform to see every AI tool and dollar across your company, run your team’s work in an app you own, and route every request to the right model.

name: AxionOrbital Space
line: Foundation models for 24/7 Earth Observation
about: AxionOrbital Space builds foundation models that enable continuous visibility through clouds and darkness. Legacy optical satellites are rendered useless 70% of the time by weather and night cycles, while Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) produces data that is unintelligible to humans and breaks standard vision pipelines. We solve this by translating raw radar backscatter into analysis-ready optical imagery in real-time. Our proprietary architecture uses deterministic one-step diffusion to transform complex radar signals into clear, photorealistic images.

name: Mendral
line: AI DevOps Engineer
about: Mendral is an AI DevOps Engineer that observes, diagnoses, acts, and learns continuously. It autonomously handles CI failures, flaky tests, slow builds, broken releases, and code reviews, improving with every build and run. Over time, Mendral evolves into a self-improving delivery system that manages performance, quality, security, and compliance, all without manual intervention.

name: Sazabi
line: AI-native observability and security platform
about: The AI-native observability and security platform for fast-moving engineering teams. Backed by tastemakers from the world's top AI companies: Vercel, Graphite, Daytona, Browserbase, LangChain, Mastra, Replit, and more.

name: Constellation Space
line: AI operating system for mega-scale satellite networks.
about: Constellation Space is building the autonomous infrastructure layer for the next generation of space networking. As satellite constellations rapidly scale from hundreds of nodes to tens of thousands, traditional ground-based orchestration fundamentally breaks down. ConstellationOS bridges this gap by providing zero-intervention network handoffs, predictive thermal load-balancing, and sub-second optical routing. Our founding team spent years building and operating satellite systems at SpaceX, Blue Origin, and NASA.

name: Byteport
line: Global upload acceleration for 1GB-100TB files.
about: Founded in 2025, Byteport is a technology company that builds mission-critical network infrastructure for robotics, satellite, AI, and enterprise applications all over the world. Businesses of every size—from new startups to public companies—use our software to accelerate file transfer online.

name: Pocket
line: Take Notes in the Real World
about: Pocket is a Y Combinator W26 company building a premium hardware plus software product in the AI voice recorder space. We are obsessed with quality and speed. We are scaling very fast in the US and now European markets and building a device experience that can become the category leader.

name: Bubble Lab
line: The intelligence layer for communities and events.
about: Bubble Lab is the all-in-one platform for running professional communities and events. From member data and operations to automations and billing, everything in one place. Try it now or book a demo!

name: Archal
line: API sandboxes, built for AI agents
about: Archal provisions sandboxes with the API environments your CI, tests, and evals need. Your coding agent can start the sandbox & environments, connect to your API integrations, run tests, and inspect state changes. Sandboxes and environments are startable within seconds and take milliseconds to reset.

name: Polymath
line: Simulation environments for training & evaluating autonomous agents
about: Polymath is a data lab focused on improving long-horizon agent capabilities and alignment. We build reinforcement learning environments for recursive self-improvement (RSI) and long-horizon software engineering.

name: Voxel Energy
line: Energy independent data centers with solar and repurposed batteries.
about: The best grid connection is no grid connection. Voxel builds vertically integrated energy generation and storage systems for data centers that bypass utility connection delays. By leveraging the vast supply of second-life EV batteries and our novel DC microgrid architecture, Voxel generates datacenter power on site and drastically reduces system cost and time-to-power.

name: Netter
line: AI agents for data science (enterprise)
about: Netter (YC P26) helps companies regain control over their data, so teams can pilot their activities with high precision. Most companies are sitting on years of valuable data, spread across different formats and disconnected tools that don't talk to each other. Netter brings technical capacity to companies that don't have an army of data engineers, and tackles their most complex data challenges. - A nursing home group was chasing unpaid invoices manually across disconnected tools. Netter centralized the collection workflows, automated reminders, real-time visibility, task routing.

name: Paradev (formerly Superset)
line: Building self-improving software
about: Paradev (formerly Superset) is an open-source IDE that helps engineers run 100s of coding agents in parallel. Our desktop app is loved by tens of thousands of engineers, and we're scaling out our effort to build a collaborative, cross-platform tool to allow users to code anywhere.

name: Datoric
line: The training data R&D engine for physical AI
about: Datoric develops custom datasets for robotics, treating research, collection, verification, and production as one continuous process. We work closely with frontier model teams to turn emerging limitations and model failures into testable data hypotheses, and run exclusive collections for specific data methods based on results. Data is collected through private invite-only applications separated by modality, customer, and trust level.

name: Servo7
line: Container unloading robots for warehouses
about: We deploy robots in warehouses to automate the most demanding job in logistics: unloading loose-loaded containers. Our customers include 3PLs (CEVA, Stord), distributors (DHL, PostNL) and many more logistics companies.

name: Ditto Biosciences
line: Evolutionary intelligence for autoimmune disease
about: Ditto Bio discovers drugs for autoimmune diseases by harnessing parasite biology. Viruses, ticks, and worms have experimented over millions of years to create proteins that control the human immune system. We use AI to identify these proteins and engineer them into next-generation autoimmune therapies. Our team is three PhD scientists from UCSF, UCSD, and UC Berkeley who have worked together for 3+ years in biotech. We have deep expertise in parasite biology, computational biology, and software for AI-based protein structure prediction

name: Libra Robotics
line: The robot workforce for infrastructure of the AI era
about: Infrastructure faces rapid expansion and labor shortages. Today, robots struggle to scale to meet customers’ high-mix work needs. Libra builds AI that engineers robots for new tasks across embodiments. We go from each new infra task to field-deployable robots 10x faster. Today, our robots are working on solar farms and piloting in data centers. Contractors pay for completed work as a service, not robots.

name: Sequence Markets
line: Low-latency execution across crypto, prediction, and tokenized assets
about: Sequence Markets lets traders execute across crypto exchanges, prediction markets, and tokenized-asset venues from one system. We built proprietary low-latency infrastructure and routing software so users can package one market view into one trade with the speed, access, and transparency execution requires.

name: Doomersion
line: Doomscroll to learn languages
about: Doomersion (formerly Doomlingo) lets you learn languages by doomsrolling! Watch TikToks in your target language that are exactly matched to your level, and as you scroll, they get a little bit harder. Gen-Z doomscrolls 2.5-3 hours a day, and if we bake immersion into that by only showing them viral videos in another language that are matched to their level, we can make the optimal language learning method addictive for people. Hence the name, doomersion. The app gained ~15k downloads in the first two weeks, and power users spend ~3+ hours daily on the app.

name: o11
line: OpenRouter wallet for paid goods and services
about: o11 helps your AI agents access apis, tools, and other paid goods and services. Instead of hacky computer use, managing credit card permissions, assigning each agent a new email, we handle all the hard parts of accessing the paid web. o11 has zero markup and gives teams better prices, easy checkout, and full auditability when purchasing with AI agents. The o11 wallet gives your AI agents access to the paid world.

name: Anchorhead
line: Evals for frontier research agents
about: We build custom evals for product teams, as a service. To build these eval sets, we source domain experts and have them turn their work into original, real world evals. For example, our research engineering experts have create tasks involving optimizing an algorithm, deploying a model, or running experiments to solve a novel problem. A grader scores the agent’s performance, and these scores serve as signals during evaluations.

name: Remy AI
line: Automating dexterous tasks in warehouses with AI-powered robots
about: Building robots and training models for automating manipulation in warehouse, starting with e-commerce 3PLs

name: Chasi
line: AI Revenue Engine for the Equipment Industry
about: Chasi deploys AI agents that help equipment dealers sell more, respond faster, and maximize fleet utilization - 24/7. One-third of the cost to build and maintain the physical world goes to equipment, yet fleet utilization across the industry often sits below 60%. Billions in assets sit idle while dealers drown in phone calls, emails, and manual data entry. Missed quotes, slow follow-ups, and disconnected systems mean lost revenue every day. Chasi plugs into a dealer's existing stack to deploy AI agents that handle sales, rentals, and service requests around the clock.

name: Ekpa
line: Building Autonomous Research Agents for Trading

name: Balance
line: Full-Stack AI Accounting
about: Balance is an AI accounting firm that helps SMBs close their monthly books. Our agents do the work of an in-house finance hire, reconciling books in real time and flagging issues before they become problems.

name: Fort
line: Strength Tracking Wearable
about: Fort is a wearable that tracks strength training for people who care about longevity. Other wearables make you manually log every rep, set, and exercise, then provide unhelpful feedback or underestimate strength-related fatigue. We use heart rate and motion data to track your strength workouts for you, then provide thoughtful, actionable feedback that helps you achieve your goals.

name: General Legal
line: Elite AI law firm for high growth companies
about: We're the elite AI law firm for high growth companies. Our firm provides exceptional, top-of-market legal work across commercial, corporate and employment law, at speeds and prices that put traditional law firms to shame.

name: Corelayer
line: AI production engineer for regulated industries
about: Corelayer is the AI-native platform for production software support, built for regulated industries like finance and healthcare. It continuously monitors alerts, logs, infrastructure, and underlying data for issues and uses agents to debug and suggest fixes. We're helping SRE, production services, and on-call engineers at companies ranging from growth-stage fintechs to Fortune 500 financial institutions spend less time on support and more on high-leverage work.

name: Booko
line: Dynamically pricing the whole economy.
about: Booko helps businesses that sell bookable time slots make more money by dynamically pricing their time. Unlike physical inventory, unsold time slots disappear forever, yet most time-slot-based businesses still rely on static pricing. We integrate with existing booking systems to adjust prices and incentives based on historical utilization, availability, and demand. Early customers see ~20% revenue uplift by selling time that would have otherwise gone unsold.

name: Foreman
line: Keeping contractors on the job site, not behind a desk.
about: Foreman is the all-in-one AI-powered project management platform built for construction contractors and the trade industry. Today, contractors run complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never designed for construction — estimates in spreadsheets, plans in email, proposals copy-pasted from old Word docs, photos scattered across phones. Nothing talks to anything else, and the admin work never stops. Foreman replaces that patchwork with a single platform that manages the full lifecycle of a construction job, from first estimate to final invoice.

name: Turnstone
line: The best model-agnostic Grokbot alternative
about: Turnstone is the best model-agnostic Grokbot alternative. Run persistent Agents on your Mac with the AI subscriptions or API keys you already have On Turnstone, you can connect multiple AI subscriptions / API keys in one place, and build a team of agents just like you would on Grokbot. When a subscription runs out, your Agent can automatically move to another connected subscription with available capacity. You can switch between accounts and model providers within an agent, and its conversation and context persists.

name: Squid
line: AI agents for power grid planning  🦑
about: We believe the electricity grid is the most important machine on Earth. If we want electrification to move fast, the teams planning and operating networks need software that is as modern as the challenge. Our thesis is simple. Better decisions come from one unified, trusted network model. When everyone works from the same model, planning becomes consistent, assumptions are visible, and progress stops getting lost in spreadsheets and static reports. Squid is AI powered grid planning in your browser.

name: Inth
line: Privacy and consent infrastructure that ships with your code
about: Inth brings together consent management, continuous privacy monitoring and AI-assisted investigation. It follows changes from code to production so engineering, marketing and legal teams can see what their sites and codebases are doing, verify their controls and get problems fixed. We're the team behind c15t, our open-source (Apache-2.0) consent framework with millions of downloads, rebuilt in v3 to run on any framework and on the server. We also maintain an open library of privacy enforcement cases, and we've completed our SOC 2 Type 2 audit. Backed by Y Combinator and Vercel.

name: Fed10
line: AI Agents for Government Affairs
about: Fed10 is a legislative consulting firm staffed by AI agents. We monitor every bill across the U.S., flag threats to your business, and deliver actionable insights — the same work a $500/hr policy consultant does, but in seconds instead of days. Built by three ex-lobbyists who passed legislation together.

name: BeeSafe AI
line: Frontier AI Defenses for Social Engineering Attacks
about: BeeSafe AI is building the frontier model layer for social engineering defense. Cyberattacks have moved from code to conversation: attackers now use AI to carry out long-term, trust-based manipulation across SMS, voice, email, and social platforms, often inside encrypted channels where defenders cannot see, detect, or stop them. BeeSafe changes that by deploying undercover AI agents that engage attackers directly, expose hidden infrastructure, and convert live adversarial conversations into actionable intelligence.

name: Meteoric
line: Drones that clear clouds over solar farms and weaken hurricanes
about: Meteoric is building drones that clear clouds over solar farms and ultimately weaken severe storms and hurricanes.

name: The Token Company
line: Compression middleware that improves LLM outputs
about: Compression middleware that removes context bloat in milliseconds, lowering costs and improving end-to-end latency. Compression is especially effective across natural language workloads. In a blind LLM arena case study with one of our customers, compressed requests increased user preference, lowered costs, and lifted purchase volume by 5%.

name: Moda
line: Your agents should never make the same mistake twice.
about: Your agents should never make the same mistake twice. Moda helps you engineer better agents from production data. Find recurring failures, understand what caused them, and build evals from real agent runs. Compare models on the tasks your users actually need. Test changes to your prompts, tools, and workflows against past production traffic before you ship. Know what broke, what to change, and whether the fix worked.

name: Maven
line: Payments for Conversational Agents
about: We enable AI chat and voice agents to collect payments through a single API call, handling card processing and PCI compliance across all payment gateways

name: Sila
line: Agentic Messenger
about: Sila is the team messenger where your people use agents to work together, becoming the infrastructure your company runs on. Our mission is to bring superintelligence to all businesses around the world.

name: Grade
line: API for performance-based payroll
about: Grade is the API for performance-based payroll. Think of us like Deel or Gusto, but our payouts are for work completed, not hours. Companies use Grade to pay AI agents and contractors based on results: tasks completed, targets hit, work delivered. We handle compliance, tax reporting, and global payouts.

name: Canary
line: Adversarial AI that breaks your AI
about: AI coding tools have made developers 100x faster but customer-facing incidents are up 43% YoY, QA hasn't kept up. Canary is the first AI QA engineer that understands your codebase. Instead of relying on flaky DOM scraping or screenshot analysis, Canary reads your source code directly to understand developer intent and catch broken user flows before they hit production. Engineering teams go from weeks of manual testing to 90%+ coverage in days. Built by a team that built coding agents at Windsurf, Cognition and Google.

name: Atlia
line: The AI-native property management company for short-term rentals
about: We use AI agents to manage short-term rental properties by running operations completely autonomously. We cut traditional human management fees in half so owners take home 20% to 30% more revenue. And we operate with near-zero boots-on-the-ground so we can scale nationwide with software margins and at venture speed in a traditionally physical industry.

name: Dream
line: Using VLMs to Catch Damage
about: Dream makes AI cameras that catch damage teams miss. Car dealerships, equipment rental companies, fleets, and more move expensive assets in and out all day, and undocumented damage is a costly leak. Dream cameras are simple to set up and work automatically. Each vehicle or machine that passes is photographed from every angle, identified, and reconstructed into a complete condition record. On return or intake, Dream instantly flags new dents, scrapes, and changes your team might miss, giving one source of truth for every asset's condition over time.

name: Tsenta
line: AI career agent that finds matching jobs & applies on your behalf
about: Tsenta is an AI career agent that matches you with jobs, applies automatically, and gets you the best offers on the market. We grew to ~$3M Annualized in three months. We built it after manually applying to over 3,000 jobs ourselves, so that candidates would always have someone on their side. Today, more than 90,000+ job seekers trust Tsenta to automate their job search.

name: Copperlane
line: Agentic Mortgage Origination
about: Copperlane helps mortgage lenders accelerate the loan process and reduce mistakes in an application. We use AI agents to understand an applicant's profile, verify their documents, and complete initial underwriting tasks.

name: Control Seat
line: AI that runs factories.
about: Control Seat builds the hardware and software that helps industrial teams see, understand, and run their operations. Our platform creates one clear source of truth across the plant. It connects the systems teams already use, brings control, monitoring, history, and machine health together, and adds an intelligence layer that continuously watches for meaningful changes. Teams can understand what happened, catch problems earlier, and act before they become downtime. The result is fewer surprises, faster decisions, and less time spent piecing together information across disconnected tools.

name: Talking Computers
line: Real-time interaction models for voice agents
about: AI lab building interaction models to make AI symbiotic with humans. Our early models sit at the Pareto frontier of intelligence and interactivity, measured by time to first audio token, and enable voice agents that are both highly capable and genuinely human-like

name: Veriad
line: AI operating system for advertising
about: Veriad is building marketing agents for enterprises to run advertising campaigns end-to-end in-house.

name: Vela
line: AI Recruiting Coordinator for Executive Search
about: Scheduling one interview panel takes a dozen emails. Then someone moves a call and you start over. Vela is an AI Scheduling Coordinator that handles it end to end. Just CC Vela on the thread like you would a person. It reaches out, finds times that work for everyone, chases the people who don't reply, reschedules when things change, and confirms. Over email, SMS, and WhatsApp, at any hour your candidate happens to respond. No dashboard. No new workflow. Your team works the way it already works, without the scheduling.

name: Cova
line: Financial infrastructure for family caregiving
about: Millions of Americans already care for someone they love. We're building a world where they can get paid for it, with the technology to make the process simple, the support to help them provide better care, and a model that gives more back to those doing the real work.

name: MochaCare
line: Agentic Management Service for Care Organizations
about: MochaCare is an agentic management service for care organizations. We handle hiring, scheduling, and client intake end-to-end so our partners can focus on growth.

name: VOYGR
line: The real-world intelligence and action layer
about: VOYGR is a better maps API every agent and AI app will need. Google says '4.2 stars, open till 10 – VOYGR knows the chef left, wait times doubled, and locals moved on. Our intelligent local search combines accurate place data with fresh web context – news, articles, and events. We expand beyond 10-15 map attributes into infinite, queryable place profiles, enabling agents to reason and act in the real world. Maps are no longer browsed – LLMs/agents use them to reason and act. 20M+ apps/websites, up to 40% of search queries, and 20% of LLM prompts need local context.

name: Poth Labs
line: The customer brain that connects data to explain customer behavior
about: Poth is an agentic research platform that connects to your company data, creates hypotheses about what might be causing problems, and validates them using both existing data and adaptive user feedback.

name: SpotPay
line: Stablecoin Global Bank Account
about: SpotPay is a global borderless neobank. We give users one account that works for everything payments related: receiving money from abroad, paying locally, spending anywhere with the SpotPay card and saving and earning on their balance.

name: Khotan (formerly Pollinate)
line: FDE as a platform for rebuilding critical operations in software.
about: Khotan is the platform for forward-deployed engineers to rebuild operations as software and maintain them. It combines your context with the infrastructure harnesses need to deploy, share, and maintain each application. Across procurement, supply chain, finance, and operations, we’ve rebuilt the systems businesses cannot afford to get wrong. Learn more at khotan.com

name: Polymorph
line: Building secure polymorphic apps
about: Team has extensive startup, AI, and math backgrounds: - founding engineer at a unicorn - ML infrastructure @ Scale AI (inference), AWS Bedrock (fine-tuning) - ads engineering @ Meta & Twitch - IMO & IOI medalists

name: TensorTest
line: Evals, RL environments and training data for creative tasks
about: TensorTest (formerly Ritivel) builds evaluations, reinforcement-learning environments, and expert training data for AI labs developing creative agents, starting with video editing. An agent can produce a valid video file without delivering an edit that meets the client’s brief. Labs need reliable ways to measure creative quality, identify failures, and give agents feedback they can learn from. Our first benchmark, TimelineBench, gives agents client video-editing jobs with raw footage, audio, and a brief.

name: Dipole Labs
line: AI-controlled optical switching for AI clusters

name: Zymbly
line: The decision-support layer for aviation ops teams to know what to do…

name: Regbase
line: Automating Corporate Compliance, Worldwide

name: Rubric AI
line: Reasoning and verification infra for AI
about: Rubric AI (backed by Y Combinator) is the reasoning and verification infrastructure for AI. We're building the human and computational layer that turns expert judgment into training signals for the world's most consequential AI systems.

name: Ossus
line: Intelligence for cultural institutions
about: We build intelligence for cultural institutions. Our first commercial product is for the literature industry with a focus on school and public libraries. It is a AI-native OS for libraries, that helps librarians save time on tedious tasks and lets them focus on their patrons.

name: Origami Robotics
line: Manipulate Anything Robot
about: We are building a "manipulate anything" model with the robot hardware that embodies it. We designed a hand-based data-collection device and a high DOF, direct drive robotic hand that match each other exactly, enabling us to eliminate embodiment gap and collect real-world data and deploy it directly. We want to scale real world manipulation data by deploying our devices "in the wild" like manufacturing factories, logistic centers to collect Tesla like data, use these data to train our model and then provide automation solutions to these industries.

name: Brumby
line: Robot Cowboys that Herd Cattle with AI Drones
about: Brumby builds autonomous drones that herd cattle. On command, our drones fly to a paddock, position themselves around the mob, and move them where they need to go. What used to take a full day of helicopters, motorbikes, and horses now runs on a schedule. We work with some of the largest cattle ranches in the world. While the drones are herding, they're also estimating animal weights, measuring grass biomass, monitoring water levels, and flagging sick animals. We're building physical AI that lets a grazier manage thousands of head across millions of acres from their phone.

name: DAIVIN!
line: Tankless Dive Gear - Breath Autonomy at Sea, Land & Space
about: DAIVIN! builds tankless dive gear that unlocks breath autonomy in extreme environments. Starting from underwater environment our mission is to remove the need for dangerous, heavy and bulky oxygen tanks in space, air and on land and replace them with water!

name: Fixture
line: An agentic CRM built for Startups
about: Fixture is a CRM for startups that helps you find your next customers and keep deals moving. It brings your customer emails, meetings, and conversations together, so you don’t have to keep your CRM up to date by hand. Fixture agents suggest prospects similar to customers you’ve won and helps you follow up on active deals. Use it in your browser or from agents like ChatGPT and Claude.

name: Aurorin CAD
line: Claude code for Mechanical Engineers
about: There are 2 problems: The first, CAD software is slow and the second, designing with it is a tedious process with many steps. Aurorin solves both of these problems by being a CAD software built from the ground up on a modern tech stack with AI at its heart. Building the CAD kernel lets us fully leverage AI while modernizing execution speed. Almost all existing CAD software (Solidworks, NX, Creo, Catia, Fusion 360, Onshape etc) use the same couple of underlying CAD kernels built in the 80's. It's common for these programs to take 4 hours to open a file.

name: Rainbrand
line: The brand layer for agents.
about: Rainbrand is the brand layer for agents. It turns a brand’s identity, guidance, and assets into shared context that agents and products can use. That context evolves with the brand, alongside the tools where it is created and managed. Starting with websites, social media, and files, Rainbrand develops and maintains versioned brand context. Through MCP or the API, connected agents and products can retrieve and update that context, then apply it to images, websites, slides, video, copy, and other brand work. We’re an ai infra company making brand as operable as software.

name: Dispatch
line: Satellites for Manufacturing in Space
about: Dispatch is building refurbishable reentry vehicles that host and return payloads for companies making ultra-high-value materials (semiconductors, biotech, and pharma) that can only be manufactured in space. Right now, these companies have no practical way to manufacture and get their products back to Earth. We solve this bottleneck. We just returned from the Mojave Desert testing our first full-scale reentry heat shield designed to protect the satellite as it returns from space at Mach 20+, built in an apartment for 100x cheaper than competitors.

name: Carrot Labs
line: AI Cost Management: Track and attribute AI spend across every provider
about: The problem: AI has quietly become one of the largest and fastest-growing line items for companies. Spend is scattered across a dozen provider consoles that each show one number at the end of the month and nothing about why it moved. There's no unified view, and no way to trace a dollar back to the customer, feature, team, or even the pull request that caused it.

name: Unifold
line: Multi-chain deposit and payment infrastructure
about: Launch crypto deposits in minutes. Unifold is a developer-first API + SDK that makes it easy for any app to accept on-chain deposits – across any chain and token – with less than 10 lines of code. We handle the full deposit flow so teams can ship faster and give users a smooth experience that actually works. If you’re building a consumer-facing on-chain product and want best-in-class deposits (or want to support more chains fast), we’d love to work with you.

name: Applied Electrodynamics, Inc.
line: A new kind of camera that can see through walls.
about: Applied Electrodynamics builds imaging systems that see through solid matter. Our team previously co-invented the iPhone touchscreen and Nest learning thermostat. We’re starting in construction, helping teams map structural elements and utilities inside walls and ceilings. The same platform extends to security screening and cargo inspection. Our mission is to make the hidden physical world machine-readable across the entire electromagnetic spectrum.

name: Wayco
line: AI operator for medlegal cases
about: Wayco is building a unified data intelligence layer for medical treatment of legal cases. From the first intake to instant settlement.

name: Shofo
line: The World's Largest Video Library
about: We are building the world’s largest video library. We've aggregated billions of videos into a searchable index and use agents to find and label the exact datasets a lab needs on demand. If a lab needs 100K hours of cooking videos where someone is holding a pan, with reasoning annotations on top, our agents search the index, extract the matching subset, route it through our labeling pipeline, and deliver a custom dataset in days, not months.

name: OpenVector
line: AI that turns any camera to an autonomous worker with real-time vision
about: OpenVector transforms any existing camera into an automated 24/7 workforce without requiring new hardware. We've built the world's fastest vision-language model inference engine that allows users to simply describe a task in plain English and automatically build a custom AI vision model to monitor their feed. When it detects an important physical event—like a stalled production cycle, a safety violation, or a waiting customer—it operates a computer just like a human to take immediate action.

name: Remix
line: Social media content auto-generated with your existing data
about: Remix is the easiest way to create content with AI. Connect your accounts, drop in photos, voice notes, or messages, and Remix instantly creates posts in your style: articles, tweets, carousels, short-form videos, even content riffing on the latest trending formats. Chat with 100s of parallel AI agents that handle everything from picking your best photos to writing copy to applying edits, all at once. Instagram was the easiest way to create photos on mobile. Remix is the easiest way to create everything else. Try it for yourself.

name: Condor Energy
line: Software for enterprise energy procurement.
about: Condor helps large electricity consumers - C&I and data centers - cut electricity costs by helping the grid. We are former electricity traders and energy physicists. We build an AI-powered software that our clients use to optimize their energy procurement - making sure they always have access to cheap & reliable power.

name: Litmus
line: Evals for humans
about: Litmus is building the most accurate framework for evaluating and benchmarking human capability, starting with software. AI will compound small differences in human capability into increasingly large differences in what people can accomplish, while making existing static benchmarks obsolete. Software is already there: AI can hill-climb any output-based evaluation, while the ability to direct it is becoming the defining advantage. Litmus applies the same approach we already use for model evals to humans – creating world-like environments, and inspecting trajectory instead of just output.

name: Martini
line: AI Video Production for Professionals
about: Martini is a collaborative, AI-native platform for professional filmmaking in the era of generative media. By integrating the best generative models into professional workflows, we enable world-class creatives to harness generative AI as a legitimate medium for film.

name: Wideframe
line: AI coworker for video editors to ship more video faster
about: Wideframe is an AI coworker for video editors. It automates the searching, labeling, organizing, and sequencing of footage so editors can ship videos faster. Why is this important? Well, it turns out that editors spend 3x more time preparing footage than actually editing. One agency said we will save their editors 10 hours per week. Another organized an entire documentary worth of footage in hours rather than weeks. He had 2,500+ videos, 500+ audio clips, across >2.5 TB of files and our agent handled them effortlessly.

name: Cardinal
line: Revenue Agents for GTM teams
about: Hey YC! We're Devi and Jianna - the founders of Cardinal. Hey guys! We’re launching Cardinal publicly today - co’s like Mintlify, Deepgram, Giga, etc. use us to build revenue agents & design how they sell. The Problem “Spray and Pray” outbound is dead. The best teams at outbound do it with extreme precision.
