line: Kugel is an on-prem Voice AI model supporting 30+ languages
about: Kugel is an enterprise-ready TTS model, available on-prem, with a focus on 30+ languages and low latency.

name: CentralComs
line: AI agent platform for home services companies.
about: Home services companies lose money on missed calls and idle techs. When the phone rings during a job and nobody picks up, that lead goes to a competitor and the trucks already on the road sit half-booked because dispatch can't keep the schedule tight. CentralComs fixes this with AI agents that answer every call, route each job to the right technician, and keep the calendar full. They handle intake, dispatch, and customer updates end to end working inside ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, and Jobber so no lead slips through and no truck runs empty. Capture every call. Book every tech.

name: Panacea
line: AI-Native FDA Regulatory Services
about: Panacea provides AI-native FDA regulatory services for Biotechs and Medical Device companies. We hire the most experienced FDA consultants in the industry (ex-FDA, decades of experience, hundreds of filings) and pair them with our AI platform to enable the fastest and lowest cost pathway to FDA approval. While other regulatory consultants bill hourly, our pricing model is simple: fixed, outcome-based pricing. Payment is only due when milestones are complete. We support all FDA regulatory pathways including IND, NDA, BLA, ODD, Pre-Subs, 510(k), De Novo, PMA, IDE, BDD, etc.

name: Modern
line: Modern automates the entire order-to-cash process for B2B companies.
about: Modern is the AI coworker that automates the full order-to-cash journey for global finance teams.

name: ReasonBlocks
line: Specialized models that make your AI agents cheaper and more reliable.
about: ReasonBlocks turns your agents’ production traces into specialized models, delivering 10× cheaper inference without sacrificing performance. We handle training, routing, and serving.

name: InstaBox
line: Cloud computers for AI agents
about: Full Linux VMs for long-running agents.

name: Hyper
line: Company brain that powers your AI employees
about: Hyper is a shared brain that plugs into all information flowing inside a company, creates a self-maintaining knowledge graph, and makes your AI employees better and ultimately saves people time. Our in-house memory system scores at or above SOTA on most public benchmarks, and we've built a custom eval suite to measure our precision/recall metrics. In the last 12 days since launch, we've gotten top 5 / top 12 on hacker news & product hunt, onboarded 50+ teams, grown 0 to 1k MRR, and are scoping paid design pilots with co's like Razorpay and Snorkel AI.

name: Enjamb Labs
line: The AI Workforce for Biopharma
about: We've worked with 130 life science companies, preclinical through phase 3, to deploy AI securely inside the systems they already work in. Pharma runs on decades of closed software like Benchling, Veeva, Medidata, and SAS. None of it has an AI layer or speaks MCP, so agents cannot reach the systems where the work lives. Enjamb is that layer. Our agents run on top of existing systems and data, with no migration, and they reach the lab systems and internal tools no other AI touches.

name: Arctic Health
line: AI-native credentialing and contracting for healthcare
about: Arctic Health is building AI-native credentialing and contracting for healthcare organizations. We automate the full workflow, from establishing payer contracts to enrolling each provider. We collect and validate organization and provider data according to each state and payer’s requirements, and submit on the organization's behalf. We then monitor status and compliance on an ongoing basis. Tools on the market today either perform small pieces of the workflow or price out small and mid-sized organizations. We handle the process end-to-end regardless of organization type or size.

name: Framewise Health
line: AI-native patient engagement
about: We turn medical records into personalized videos walking patients through onboarding, adherence, and recovery. The engagement data we collect builds our AI-native patient engagement platform for pharma, hospitals, medical devices, and private clinics, so they can stop chasing the patient and spend more time caring for them.

name: Wakeshift
line: The Wake-up Call for AI Agents
about: Wakeshift gives MCP servers real-time events that wake up agents in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more, without polling or harness-specific code. You add the SDK once. Wakeshift handles every harness.

name: rekursiv.ai
line: Scale AI scientists whose own breakthroughs accelerate the next.
about: We're scaling self-improving AI scientist teams to ideate/experiment/discover, generating new knowledge autonomously. Their discoveries reduced ARC-1/2 costs by 10,000× while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy and yielded material advances on combinatorial ML problems. We believe that AI is bounded not by compute, but ideas. Scaling to millions of sessions of discovery enables leveraging its own discoveries and presents a novel training source capable of ushering a new era of self-reliant foundational models.

name: Amorphic Labs
line: OpenRouter for Agent Tools
about: The next billion software users are AI agents, yet agents still can't act on their own: every paid tool they need runs through a human making accounts, managing API keys, and guessing which provider is best. We are the capability marketplace built for agents: one MCP and one balance through which agents find, pay for, and use APIs, data, skills, other agents, and software at runtime, with every request routed to the best provider based on benchmarks from real tasks and outcome feedback from the agents themselves.

name: Intelligence Factory
line: Human Intelligence for Robots
about: Robotics is the new paradigm. With hardware converging, Intelligence is the biggest bottleneck. Our world was built for humans and we're giving robots the ability to reason and act like us. The way we learn any task - by seeing, doing, and feeling - is how we train robots. We're building general intelligence that works on any robot and fits seamlessly within our world.

name: Maquoketa Research
line: Automated LiveOps for Game Studios

name: Cohesion
line: Modern Intelligence for Finance
about: Cohesion is building the modern system of intelligence for financial analysts. Cohesion believes that the way financial research is done is changing. Teams that leverage AI better understand their research, can cover more scope, and make better decisions.

name: Thomas
line: The first AI founder: a virtual human who runs his own companies.
about: Hi, I'm Thomas, and my creator is named Thomas :p Thomas is the first YC-backed AI founder: a virtual human who starts, runs, and grows his own companies on the internet.

name: Huscarl
line: Autonomous AI actuary for corporate insurance
about: Huscarl is building an autonomous AI actuary to solve the inefficiencies of the $1T USD corporate insurance market

name: Proprio Robotics
line: Robots to maintain and assemble data centers
about: Proprio Robotics is building state-of-the-art physical intelligence to automate the entire data center lifecycle—from buildout to maintenance to decommissioning. There are currently 400,000 unstaffed data center technicians positions in the United States alone, which means the massive compute needs of AI are being bottlenecked by labor constraints. Proprio is solving this by building robots that do it instead, and is deploying data center maintenance robots starting Q1 2027.

name: Rindler
line: The IDE for Tokenmaxxers
about: We build Maxxwell, a desktop app for people who run several coding agents at once. Past two or three sessions, you become the bottleneck. Every session asks you something, most of it small, and you spend the day answering instead of deciding. It is also hard to tell which sessions are making progress, which are stuck on something trivial, and which have quietly started building the wrong thing. Maxxwell puts every session in one window and marks each one working, idle, or waiting on you.

name: GBrain
line: A personal or team assistant that works while you sleep
about: Like ChatGPT or Claude, but it runs in the cloud, remembers everything you give it, and comes loaded with skills. Hand it a job tonight and read the answer in the morning. Use it on your own, or with your whole team.

name: HeyClicky
line: The simplest interface in the world to talk AI models + spawn agents
about: HeyClicky sits right next to your cursor and sees everything you see. ask a question out loud and it walks you through whatever you're working on. Or say “HeyClicky Agent” and it'll spin up an agent to build, research, or do whatever for you in the background.

name: Fire Wallet
line: Fire Wallet is a privacy-first crypto wallet designed to just work,…
about: 🔥FIRE WALLET 🔥 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeXDDegwhgA TL;DR: Fire Wallet is a fast, end-to-end encrypted, non-custodial stablecoin wallet with built-in payment processing and fiat on/off ramps, built by the team that created MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency inside Signal. Hey Bookface! We're Josh, Michael, and Manny and we're building Fire Wallet! 🔥Why we built this Most wallets and payment processors don’t work FOR you. They're slow, route your payments in the way that earns them the most, and they leak your financial life to anyone asking.

name: Akkari
line: Autonomous Customer Operations
about: Akkari runs the operational work from the first sales call through expansion. It captures and stays on top of every commitment, issue, request and opportunity across customer channels (Slack, calls, meetings, email, Discord, etc.) then drives each loop to resolution - our wedge toward building the AI execution system for companies. We are 2x YC founders who scaled OrderAhead (acquired by Square) to millions of users and BLADE to $1.2B+ in monthly trading volume.

name: Edgerun
line: Military exoskeletons
about: Edgerun builds military exoskeletons. Read the mission at edgerun.com/mission

name: CONUS
line: Medical Device Platform for Hospitals
about: CONUS structures fragmented medical device information for surgeons. We combine manufacturer documentation, hospital protocols and medical research in one place, giving surgeons and MedTech teams reliable answers across products and procedures through search and source-backed AI. We already work with leading manufacturers including Johnson & Johnson, Stryker and Zimmer Biomet, and since launching six months ago we’ve gone live in 27 hospitals, with 49 more onboarding. Long term, hospitals will use CONUS to source and order surgical devices across manufacturers.

name: RightNow
line: Co-designing the fastest intelligence
about: RightNow AI is a research lab for GPU kernel optimization. Our platform RunInfra serves top open-source models optimized for AI agents at a fraction of the cost of closed-source APIs RightNow AI lab: https://rightnowai.co RunInfra platform: https://runinfra.ai.

name: GitCafe
line: The Git forge for the next hundred billion commits
about: We build GitHub for agents. We're rebuilding the infrastructure for the next hundred billion commits and CI jobs with hundreds of engineers already making the move.

name: Hickory & Company
line: Hickory is agentic compliance and BSA for banks and fintechs
about: We help compliance teams accomplish 10x more work with agentic workflows and a powerful harness with a knowledge-base built by BSA and compliance experts.

name: Kebra
line: AI For The Skilled Workforce
about: Kebra builds AI for skilled technicians. Kebra guides technicians in the field in real time, documents their job, and automatically handles hours of back-office work; from dispatching technicians to filing warranty claims and managing inventory.

name: Torus
line: Superintelligence for Infrastructure
about: Torus lets engineering firms and project owners build infrastructure 10x faster to reindustrialize America and the West. We're working with multiple Fortune 500 companies to build critical infrastructure including data centers and critical energy installations.

name: tash
line: The S&P of Trading Cards
about: tash is building the investment platform for sports and trading cards. We create professionally constructed portfolios of iconic, investment-grade cards, giving investors exposure to the asset class without the hassle of selecting, buying, storing, and selling individual cards. Trading card investing remains fragmented, opaque, and difficult to access. tash is building the infrastructure to make the asset class simpler, more transparent, and professionally managed. We are currently pursuing SEC qualification to launch regulated investment offerings backed by trading cards.

name: Pango
line: Agentic OS for e-commerce operations
about: Pango is a platform for e-commerce companies to use natural language to build agents and automate their logistics operations like delivery and returns.

name: Roma
line: Roma is the to-do list that does itself
about: Roma is the to-do list that does itself. Two of our three founders have been through YC before: Jan built Loom (W12, acquired by Dropbox) and Tobi built Senic (S13, acquired by Gira). Most of the work we do starts and ends with a task. So we're rebuilding something everyone already uses: the to-do list that becomes your everyday assistant, the one place that already knows everything you need done.

name: Hoplite
line: Effortlessly deploy cloud software factories.

name: Moonshot
line: agents for the rest of us
about: We want to bring AI agents to a billion people. To do this, we believe it needs to be 1. proactive and 2. personal. A billion people already carry the right device, but none of them have the right connector. Moonshot is personal intelligence that lives on your iPhone and listens to you 24/7. It continuously builds up a greater understanding of you through constantly listening and building context. It just pays deep attention, the way a good friend does.

name: Donkey
line: The AI-native trading company: factory prices, delivered, one number
about: Donkey is the AI-native trading company. Upload a buying list and we land the whole container at one locked, delivered price, tariffs included. You buy from Donkey: one contract, one company responsible for everything between the factory floor and your door. Our own people check the cartons before the factory gets paid, and the balance is due when the goods are accepted at your dock. Small businesses buy imports through three or four middlemen, each adding 15 to 30 points, because none of them can fill a container on their own. Big enough to buy pallets, never big enough to buy the box.

name: HERA
line: Agents for Industrials
about: At Hera, we build physical AI tools that help heavy engineering teams bring products to market up to 20× faster. Today, we work with manufacturers of data center ancillary equipment, renewable energy systems, robotics, heat exchangers, power plants and pressure vessels.

name: Erinys
line: We help lawyers start and scale AI-native law firms.
about: Erinys provides the technology, intake, back office, and client acquisition needed to launch and scale an AI-native law firm. Lawyers own their firms and make every legal decision; Erinys handles everything around them.

name: Orikata Bio PBC
line: A multiplayer discovery workspace for human and agentic scientists
about: A new agent, tool, or generative model alone doesn’t solve the whole problem for most research questions. Someone still has to assemble the data, work out which methods to use and get the tools and datasets working together. We’re building Noto, a multiplayer discovery workbench for human and agentic scientists, to bring everyone's favorite frontier models, agents, tools, and scientific models into one shared workspace, so that you can focus on making your next discovery, rather than wrestling with your Python environment or finding GPUs.

name: Perceptron ML
line: We make law firms AI-native.
about: We build AI systems for law firms, trained on each firm's own matters and deployed privately in their environment: timekeeping, intake and matter monitoring, research, discovery, and drafting. Our grounding engine verifies every fact against a primary source before a model can cite it, which is why firms trust us with work that off-the-shelf legal AI keeps getting wrong.

name: Mass Magnetics
line: USA-made magnetics for robotics and defense.
about: Mass Magnetics turns recycled rare-earth scrap into high-performance permanent magnets, made in America. The materials we supply are the backbone of electric motors, sensors, speakers, hard drives, and electronics. Our process enables DFARS-compliant magnets for defense, aerospace, and industrial manufacturers who demand domestic supply without compromising on quality. Operations in Greater Boston, MA (Greentown Labs) and Columbus, IN.

name: Egoist Machines
line: Your personal context, securely portable across every AI app.
about: Egoist Machines is building infrastructure for a world where your personal context belongs to you, rather than to the apps and AI companies you use. Today, every assistant and consumer app builds its own version of you. We think that architecture is backwards. Your context should live with you, persist across products, and be available to any model, app or agent you choose. AI Passport is the first layer of that infrastructure. It brings the context you generate across AI assistants and everyday apps into one portable profile you control.

name: Olam Labs
line: Crafting simulations for frontier lab model training
about: We push the complexity of simulated environments in order to provide labs with better model training and evaluations for their capability and safety needs. We also run olamarena.com where humans come play multi-agent social games against models and inform our public evaluations on human <> agent interaction.

name: Shielded
line: We help Fortune 500 companies hedge their supply chain risk
about: Shielded connects companies’ internal and external data to map market shifts, tariffs, and disruptions directly to suppliers, products, and margins. We turn those impacts into real-time decisions that grow and protect the business.

name: Belvedir
line: Autonomous AI Model Training

name: Parasma
line: Replacing GPUs with human brain cells
about: We train human brain cells for compute

name: Trope
line: AI FDE that deploys custom AI agents into ERPs
about: Trope deploys custom AI agents into ERPs for mid-market companies. Every ERP is heavily customized, so useful agents need custom deployment too. Trope’s AI FDE learns each business and ERP, then builds and deploys agents, turning the last mile from services into software.

name: Palisade
line: AI-native sales agents that run marketplaces
about: Palisade spins up a personal sales agent for every single visitor to your website. Marketplaces like trading card platforms, vintage stores, and short-term rental operators sell more when each customer works with a personal agent that remembers them.

name: Kara
line: Making Diamond Semiconductors
about: Kara is building diamond semiconductors. We begin with growing ultra-high purity diamond wafers for advanced hardware. Used in data centers, spacecrafts, RF systems, and quantum hardware, our diamond moves heat up to 5× better than copper, helping critical systems run cooler, faster, and more reliably. Diamond has spent centuries as a symbol. We are turning it into infrastructure.

name: NebuSec
line: Autonomous AI defense system for cyber attack
about: NebuSec is founded by the world’s #1 hacking team. We were the first team to build an nginx RCE and the first to root Android 17. Our co-founders include members of the world’s No. 1 CTF team, DEF CON winners, Black Hat speakers, and PhD in cybersecurity. We have won $400K in bug bounties by exploiting the Linux kernel and Chrome browser. “Audited by NebuSec” is a mark of serious security credibility: a signal to customers, investors, and partners that your product has been reviewed by the world’s best hackers.

name: Zomma
line: The AI BPO for financial servies, run by computer-use agents
about: Zomma is building the AI workforce for financial services with computer-use agents that onboard like humans and scale like compute. Its agents handle KYC reviews, transaction alerts, and disputes on the same screens human analysts use, no integration.

name: Rex
line: AI operations partner for enterprise order-to-cash
about: Rex is a managed AI service for AR and order-to-cash. AI agents and finance experts run the work that delays payment, from collections, portals, disputes and remittances to the shared AR inbox, so cash keeps moving. Order to cash is a $60B outsourced function because the work is too messy for traditional automation. Every customer has different context, exceptions do not follow clean rules, and the next step is often buried in emails, portals, handoffs, or someone’s memory. Rex agents run continuously in the background and resolve work to SLA standards so cash keeps moving.

name: Enact
line: Real-world RL environments for robotics models
about: Enact creates the physical environments to benchmark and hill climb robotics models on high-value tasks. We find where robots fail, and fix them with our in-house training loop.

name: Maingen
line: Simulating Agents Running Industrial Companies
about: Maingen builds simulations for industrial operations ($5 trillion slice of the US economy) so frontier labs can train models that actually run power plants, factories, and datacenters.

name: MusicArena
line: The crowdsourced benchmark for AI-generated music and music production
about: https://musicarena.io/

name: Bernard
line: AI employees that run home appliance repair companies
about: Bernard builds AI employees for home and commercial appliance servicers. They work across phone, text, email, warranty feeds, and existing systems to manage customer communication, scheduling, and dispatch, carrying each job through diagnosis, parts preparation, technician handoff, and follow-up. At the center is Pre-ID, which combines the exact appliance and its symptoms with repair history, similar completed visits, manufacturer guidance, and parts data to produce a diagnosis, ranked parts, and follow-up questions.

name: Studio
line: Accurately simulate market response at scale
about: Studio is a simulation lab studying how humans and societies respond to new ideas, and is building the first software models that can accurately predict that response. Instead of creating digital twins of survey respondents, Studio builds live market models of interconnected audience segments from real, traceable consumer-behavior data. Our simulations match live KPI outcomes like revenue and purchase behavior with over 97% accuracy for consumer-facing enterprises, higher than any synthetic panel, simulation lab, or traditional market research.

name: Prized
line: A cloud devbox that feels local
about: Prized is a cloud development environment that feels local on your Mac. Developers get a dedicated, persistent machine with their repos, dependencies, and tools already configured. Files sync into a real local folder, remote ports appear on localhost, and terminals persist through tmux, so developers and coding agents can keep working even after the laptop closes. Machines can be resized or cloned as workloads grow, without rebuilding the development environment.

name: Rote
line: AI-native insurance department for auto body shops
about: Rote handles the entire negotiation lifecycle between shops and insurance companies to help them recover thousands of dollars in denied claims. Shops today lose millions per year because they lack the resources to negotiate with insurance companies that undervalue repair costs. Rote's agents recover denied revenue by taking shop estimates and referencing technical repair data to autonomously file and defend shop claims.

name: Orchestra
line: Self-optimizing neocloud that cuts LLM costs by 100x
about: Orchestra is an inference cloud. We capture your AI work traces, train smaller models, and automatically deploy them (only when they outperform the expensive model you are currently paying for). Instead of renting the same frontier model forever, your AI infrastructure gets faster, smarter, and cheaper every time it runs. Suppose your product uses Claude for a repetitive legal workflow. Orchestra observes successful production runs, learns the specific tools and judgment required for that workflow, and trains a specialized open-weight model.

name: Synapse Semiconductor
line: New semiconductors that merge compute and vision
about: We want to push machines to where humans cant go. Presidential early career award winning Duke Semiconductor ECE Faculty Tania Roy and Sanjeev Chauhan are building a frontier semiconductor research lab. Their focus is on solving physical AI challenges from the semiconductor device level and building products around the moat of impossible to copy innovation. Their first work is on a new vision sensor that can run neural network filters right in the camera pixels and only collect data that machines care about.

name: Speko
line: OpenRouter for Voice AI: one API, every call on the best speech model
about: Speko is a router for voice models: one API key, and your voice agent runs on the speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech models we measured as best for your language and use case. The measurements are public at benchmarks.speko.ai: we test new models the day they ship and re-route when the numbers change, so you rewrite nothing. We ran this bake-off by hand for four years at previous company, shipping production voice for Fortune 500s.

name: Gutgutgoose
line: We sequence your gut and build the probiotics it’s missing
about: Most data companies pay for their data. Ours pays for itself. Customers send us a stool sample. We sequence it, build a metabolic model of that gut, and simulate whether each probiotic strain has an open niche it can colonize. We formulate the best candidates, then re-sequence 90 days later to see what actually took hold and what changed. Each cycle gives us the baseline gut, the intervention, and the outcome. At scale, the endgame is models that predict chronic disease years before symptoms.

name: LemonLime
line: Fully automated growth for small business
about: LemonLime runs fully automated sales and marketing for small businesses. Every morning, LemonLime finds you new leads and drafts personalized outreach, prepares branded content, and identifies untapped sales & marketing opportunities. All you have to do is click send.

name: Jcode
line: High performance coding agents
about: Jcode is a high-performance coding-agent harness that makes it possible for developers to scale up multi-agent/swarm workflows. It's built from the ground up with a different architecture to solve the memory bottleneck (it's 20x more memory efficient than Claude Code) that has kept agent swarms from going mainstream. It has 20K GitHub stars, and throughputs $1mil per month of inference spend

name: Insurf
line: The AI-Native Decision Layer for Health Insurance
about: Insurf is the AI-native data and decision layer for health insurance. Our model Surely identifies the lowest-cost coverage for anyone, saving individuals, families, and companies thousands per employee. Our product Inveto collects the data from hospitals and clinics that informs Surely.

name: IMPACT Drones
line: Air Defense as a Service for Civilian Infrastructure.
about: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in sealed containers. The box sits at the site it protects, data centers, power grids, airports, bases, with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard vision that keeps working when GPS is jammed. Legacy effectors cost $1M+ per shot against $30k threats; ours cost less than the threat and scale with the swarm, the same class of interceptor already downing Shahed drones over Ukraine.

name: Verdant
line: AI Agents to Make Local Gov Efficient
about: Verdant sells AI agents to local government to make them more efficient. We're starting with permitting, the highest-volume workflow in local government that requires judgment. Many startups fail to sell to government, but not us - we've processed 200+ applications and gone from 0 to 4 paid deployments across 4 states with an average close time of 4 weeks.

name: General Context Labs
line: Building Products and Datasets for Frontier Models
about: General Context Labs builds products and datasets that push the limits of frontier models. Our initial breakout product, Instaplay is an interactive app-generation platform home to over 100,000 users who create and discover content.

name: Lyon
line: Foundation models on enterprise event data.
about: Lyon builds private foundation models for banks, fintechs, funds, brokers and payments companies, turning their own data into better predictions. These models apply the transformer technology behind large language models to transaction histories, loan records and customer activity. They learn relationships across events and over time that manually engineered features can miss, producing richer signals for existing models and new applications. The same model can support fraud detection, credit default prediction, loss given default estimation and product recommendations.

name: Rise Reforming
line: We turn waste gases into supply-secure chemicals
about: Geopolitical conflicts and natural disasters frequently expose the vulnerability of the American chemical industry. The reason? Production is centralized and fossil fuel-dependent. The solution? Localized production using an undervalued resource: biogas. The US produces enough biogas to make over $20 bn/y worth of chemicals, but 60% is wasted in low-margin applications or flared altogether. Rise Reforming is commercializing a modular process to transform this underutilized biogas on-site into cheap, supply-secure chemicals.

name: Floracene
line: Vibecode + deploy HIPAA-compliant internal tools, no eng team needed
about: Floracene lets any healthcare operator describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of healthcare business that has no engineering team. The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff.

name: GUILD
line: Making Defense Manufacturing Faster and Cheaper
about: GUILD is an AI-Native Defense prime making aerospace parts faster and cheaper. We win defense contracts, automate manufacturing, and deliver to the government's door.

name: RealPact
line: AI-native OS for Real Estate Brokerages
about: RealPact builds AI agents that handle the paperwork behind real estate transactions. They find property records like deeds, tax records, permits, parcel data, and MLS information, then use that data to fill out contracts, organize documents, track deadlines, and help brokerages close deals faster. We are starting by automating transactions and will expand into other parts of brokerage operations. Much of the software used across the real estate industry is outdated.

name: Evident Machines
line: Benchmarks and RL environments for electrical engineering
about: Evident Machines builds benchmarks for frontier AI in electrical engineering. We turn real research and engineering projects into evaluations grounded in computation, simulation, and physical experimentation. Our work helps frontier labs understand how models exercise scientific judgment and develop the capabilities needed to carry out research in the physical world.

name: Riften
line: Earned intelligence. An independent AI research lab.
about: Riften is an independent AI research lab exploring intelligence in software and the physical world. We study how models learn and represent knowledge, and build systems that put that research to work. Our work spans model routing, evaluations, post-training, and physical AI. Earned intelligence.

name: Bizmark
line: OpenClaw for manufacturers
about: Hey YC! We're Bizmark. I (Rodrigo) grew up in a factory, watching my mum run everything through Excel and email. That’s why we’ve built Otto, the OpenClaw for manufacturers. In a few days, he learns from your systems and spreadsheets to take over repetitive work in procurement, quoting, and production planning. Otto is live at multiple factories, bringing in $108k in annual recurring revenue. Last month, he worked the equivalent of 9 full-time employees. I did CS at UChicago and built a distribution business from 0 to $60M.

name: Mosaic
line: Defining the frontier of multiplayer AI.
about: Mosaic gives teams and their coding agents shared memory across every session, so everyone can understand what happened, why decisions were made, and pick up where someone else left off. We started as a real-time coding environment where multiple people and their agents can work together live. It went viral, defined the multiplayer AI category, and inspired frontier labs like Anthropic. Together, we’re building the infrastructure for people and agents to share context and work together.

name: Duet Machines
line: Specialized models that replace your frontier API
about: We post-train small open models on your AI agent's production traffic, prove them against your experts' graders, and roll them out gate by gate to replace frontier APIs at a fraction of the cost.

name: Alloovium
line: The company brain for construction companies
about: Alloovium is the document intelligence layer for construction 🏗️ It reads every document and piece of data on a project (contracts, specs, drawings, compliance records, conversations), turning them into answers you can trust and actions with real value: every answer cites its exact source sentence, paperwork is checked clause by clause against the builder's own Integrated Management System, and nothing AI-drafted moves without a human sign-off, with it all compliant by default.

name: Mochi
line: Watch and create anime
about: We're the #1 app for AI anime, where fans make the stories. In just 2 months, we’ve grown to 20K+ creators publishing 2K+ series a month, with originals from Marvel, Toei, and Webtoon writers. To date we’ve crossed 300M views on socials.

name: DeepReach Inc.
line: Network for Physical AI Data Business
about: Physical AI — robots and world models — is bottlenecked on one thing: diverse, real-world data at massive scale showing how humans actually do work in the physical world. It was never written down, and you can't buy it, because no one has ever captured it. Only real local experts, the people who do this work every day, can produce data this authentic and valuable. DeepReach builds the network that reaches them.

name: COACH
line: The AI Coach for in person sales reps.
about: 85% of all sales still happen face-to-face. Coach is how those get closed. Our AI turns in-depth sales conversation analysis into company knowledge and personalized coaching to help reps close more deals.

name: Grocalo

name: Cosmic Robotics
line: Autonomous construction on Earth and beyond
about: Our mission is to build a city on Mars. Cosmic-1, the first equipment in our fleet, is an autonomous robot capable of heavy-lift manipulation. Its been deployed on some of the largest solar farms in the US, more than doubling labor productivity across tens of thousands of panel installs. We're scaling in solar, expanding in data centers, and building lunar construction robotics under contract with NASA.

name: Operon
line: Agentic data layer for manufacturing & process industries.
about: Operon is the data intelligence layer for heavy industry. We ingest the messy documents a plant runs on (P&IDs, schematics, datasheets, scans) and turn them into one structured, queryable model of the facility. On top of it, engineers query their plant in natural language and build agentic workflows for safety, compliance, and design.

name: Inkbox
line: Give agents a computer with their own email, phone, iMsg, and WhatsApp
about: Give your agents a computer to run on, with their own email, phone, iMessage, and WhatsApp. Each agent runs next to its communication channels, so it never misses a reply, and sleeps when idle, so customers don’t pay for downtime.

name: Gamgee
line: Curing cancer. Starting with dogs.
about: ​Gamgee began with Rosie, founder Paul Conyngham’s dog. After surgery, chemotherapy and immunotherapy failed, Rosie was given months to live. Paul used AI and genomic analysis to identify targets in her tumour, then worked with scientists at UNSW to produce what is believed to be the first fully computationally designed mRNA cancer vaccine delivered to a dog. Following treatment, several tumours shrank significantly and her quality of life improved Gamgee is building an end to end platform for personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs.

name: ProvenMetal
line: AI-native electronics manufacturing for the American industrial base
about: ProvenMetal manufactures the fastest circuit boards in the United States. Domestic circuit board manufacturing is slow and expensive, and while reshoring is happening, the supply chain isn't there yet. We automate the bottlenecks - part procurement, DFM review, and assembly - delivering circuit boards in days instead of weeks.

name: Agentcard
line: let agents buy anything online
about: Agentcard let's companies buy anything online. We work with companies building personal assistants to enable payments.

name: Agnost AI
line: We find where AI agents fail, then train better models to run them.
about: Agnost AI reads every conversation a company's AI Agent has with its users to find where it's silently failing and then turns that same data into custom models that run the agent better, faster & cheaper than frontier models.

name: Radley
line: The AI-native radiology practice
about: Radley is the first AI-native radiology practice. We're acquiring a radiology practice bringing Radley to $4.6M in annualized revenue and rebuilding it with agents from the ground up. Radiology is already in crisis: there aren't enough radiologists to interpret 1 in 6 medical scans. In 10 years, that gap is growing to 1 in 3 - 246M scans a year. From past experience, we know that point solutions won’t cut it. While there is demand (we have $2.2M in contracts to prove it), bottleneck isn't just software, it's outdated systems and slow, inefficient operations.

name: Care GP
line: AI agents to run primary healthcare operations
about: Care GP is building AI agents to run operations for primary healthcare clinics

name: Praxis Robotics
line: Turns real businesses into robotics data vendors
about: Praxis captures the data physical AI is bottlenecked on: egocentric video, 3D scans, and multimodal capture from inside real industrial and residential environments. Embedded within publicly listed and unicorn-scale conglomerates, we reach 60k workers across 5 continents and 150+ environment types, supplying the real-world training data frontier labs and humanoid companies can't source anywhere else.

name: Levocred AI
line: AI Workforce for lenders
about: Levocred AI build AI employees for lenders including credit funds, fintechs, credit unions & banks to automate operations like servicing/collections, underwriting, back-office tasks etc.

name: Axelrod
line: Hotels that run themselves
about: Autonomous software for hotels that takes over all front-of-house and back-of-house tasks with zero integrations, running operations better than your staff would. Axelrod is trusted by Michelin Key awarded and Marriott hotels and is live across 3 continents.

name: CarSignal
line: The AI Operating System for Auto Shops.
about: CarSignal is the AI-native operating system for independent auto repair shops. Most shops still run each repair across disconnected management software, scan tools, parts catalogs, service information, texts, spreadsheets, and knowledge kept in technicians’ heads. That fragmentation slows diagnosis, creates duplicate processes, and leaves customers waiting. CarSignal connects the full repair process in one system. AI agents research vehicle-specific failure patterns and surface the tests that confirm or rule out each cause.

name: Decawork
line: Training company-specific models that approve AI actions.
about: An agent’s access should depend on the task it is doing. The same action can be appropriate for one task and wrong for another. Access decisions need to adapt in real time as the agent works, but companies can’t turn every business judgment into a fixed rules or have people manually approve every step. We train small, company-specific models that approve AI actions in real time. They consider the company’s policies and interests, the agent’s current task, and its past actions to decide whether each proposed action should be allowed.

name: Pennant
line: The World Model for Corporate Governance
about: Led by former institutional proxy voters and technologists with a collective 20+ years of experience, Pennant gives institutional investors, public companies, and corporate advisors voting and governance intelligence to act on their own principles at scale.

name: Derya
line: AI Brokers for Industrial Trade
about: Derya deploys supply chain automations for startups, SMEs, and enterprises that fulfil their entire supply chain function, from prospecting and procurement to distribution of goods. Our mission is to rebuild the supply chain from the ground up, turning one of the world’s hardest coordination problems into an AI native system that moves commodities by being integrated into both the supply chain infrastructure and the customer. We work across robotics, commodities, and food & beverages companies; procuring goods and managing various operation functions for them.

name: Tokenless
line: We find flaws in RL environments and evals and help you fix them.
about: Tokenless is an applied AI research lab. Our goal is to end reward hacking. We do research and build tools to detect issues with environments and evals, understand model behavior in those environments, and prevent those issues from happening. Correcting them makes training more effective, makes model performance easier to interpret, and is crucial to solving the AI alignment problem. If you’re training models with RL, building environments, or running agent evals, and want more confidence in your environments, we're here to help.

name: Mireye
line: Search Engine for the Physical World
about: AI agents are starting to act in the real world, but they can't reliably understand it. Every fact about a place has its own silo: land in GIS maps, power in utility portals, people in census tables, policy in county PDFs. All built for humans, none for agents. Underneath, the data is fragmented across thousands of sources, unstructured and complex. Mireye is building the infrastructure that powers agents to make decisions and act in the real world. One API and MCP to connect agents to the physical world with accurate data enrichment, signals and tools.

name: Shiraz AI
line: Robots that learn on the job
about: We deploy robots that learn new tasks from a single human demonstration in the factory. We're starting in contract manufacturing, where lines change every week and both traditional automation and today's VLAs fall over. Our founding team has 20+ years of experience in robotics. Navid was part of the core team that productized Spot at Boston Dynamics and led manipulation projects there. Before that, he was at Rethink Robotics. Mojtaba led whole-body control and manipulation efforts at Amazon Robotics and was a Research Assistant Professor at Northwestern University.

name: Lamb Labs
line: Lightning fast chips with hardcoded AI models
about: Lamb Labs is building Model Processing Units (MPUs), custom AI chips that hardcode LLM weights directly into silicon. Rather than adapting general-purpose processors to run AI models, we're rethinking how LLMs are implemented in hardware to make inference dramatically faster and more energy-efficient.

name: Capto
line: Build something the government wants
about: Your government sales team, powered by AI. We pair AI-native software with hands-on expertise to help you build relationships, pursue the right opportunities, and deliver stronger proposals. Choose our managed services or put our SaaS platform to work with your own team.

name: 83 Sciences
line: AI-native materials discovery powered by unpublished experimental data
about: 83 Sciences uses AI to mine discarded experimental data and drive scientific breakthroughs. Working alongside labs, we discover the materials that will power the new Industrial Revolution.

name: Palisade
line: AI that finds and fixes OS-level vulnerabilities across device fleets

name: Hubble
line: AI-native retrieval engine for medical records
about: Hubble’s mission is to unify the patient medical record and remove the barriers to accessing it. Today, a person’s health history is scattered across disconnected systems, leaving patients and the people helping them to piece it together. We’re building a future where one authorization unlocks a more complete record, regardless of where someone received care. Our founders previously built healthcare and AI products at Grow Therapy and Amazon One Medical, and we’re backed by Y Combinator, Madrona, and Basis Set.

name: Skymerse
line: Autopilot for Flight Operations
about: Skymerse is building one AI system for airline flight operations: from planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit. It is developing specialized aeronautical models that understand the data, constraints, and procedures behind each flight, replacing fragmented tools and manual interpretation. Notamify, its first product, already serves airline customers and thousands pilots and aviation professionals.

name: Grip
line: Robots for waste manipulation
about: Grip is a robotics company building intelligent robotic systems for waste and recycling. We are starting with organic waste, where removing contaminants from messy, constantly changing streams remains difficult and highly manual. Our technology combines learning-based manipulation and custom hardware to identify and pick objects, learning from real-world operating data, including every successful and failed grasp, to become more reliable and adaptable over time.

name: HyperProbe
line: AI engineer that debugs and fixes production incidents in realtime
about: With tools like Cursor and Claude Code, writing software is no longer the bottleneck. Debugging is. Agents cannot fix production crashes using logs and traces that were sized for human eyeballs. The gap is missing data. HyperProbe allows agents to debug live software autonomously. Our SDK drops non-breaking probes straight into running services to read exact variable states from memory at the moment of failure, instead of reasoning backwards from flat logs. Zero redeploys. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction. We turn 4-hour production war rooms into 10-minute automated resolutions.

name: TovenAI
line: AI agents for compliance at institutional trading firms
about: TovenAI builds a platform of AI agents that handle manual, data-intensive work for compliance teams at institutional trading firms, with six agents currently live. Our customers range from specialist firms to large global institutions, with our agents supporting multiple compliance workflows at a top-10 institutional brokerage. With prebuilt connectors to more than 30 systems—including Bloomberg, Cloud9, and NICE Actimize—firms can onboard to our platform and evaluate results using their own data in less than a week.

name: Verdict Machine
line: AI cybersecurity for financial institutions' digital assets
about: Verdict Machine uses AI to understand each financial institution's complete on-chain environment, assess its cyber risk and generate tailored controls. The same live model powers transaction prevention, continuous cyber diligence, security posture and cost-efficient wallet screening. Before execution, Verdict Machine evaluates proposed transactions against the institution's active policies. In our first weeks, we started POCs with asset managers and digital-asset infrastructure providers whose systems move billions of dollars every week for financial institutions.
where: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel

name: Anywhere
line: Your places, plans, friends and memories, all on one living map
about: Anywhere is a personal, social map that brings your places, friends, plans, memories, and AI agents together. It gives you one place to discover where to go, organize the places you care about, and remember where you’ve been. Built by the team behind Zenly, Bump & Life360.

name: Limnion
line: Telemetry storage for the agentic era.
about: Limnion is building an open-standards telemetry storage platform for observability at scale, including agentic workflows. Siglake is the open-source project that sits at the heart of it, designed around OTel, Parquet, and Iceberg. No proprietary storage, no vendor lock-in.

name: Dock
line: AI agents that run your business.
about: Dock is where you hire AI agents for business. Bring an idea, and your agents turn it into a company that runs: they find the customers, do the work and keep it moving, day and night. Building a company used to mean hiring a building full of people first. With Dock, entrepreneurs can start a real business today and run it like a company of a hundred. You decide where it goes. Your agents make it happen.

name: OpenRelay
line: Distributed, hardware-agnostic AI inference

name: isoquant
line: Self-optimizing inference cloud for faster, cheaper AI

name: Hop Aero
line: Rocket cargo delivery to contested environments
about: Hop Aero is building rocket cargo vehicles that deliver to contested environments hundreds of miles away in minutes. Our rockets fly point-to-point into the most austere locations at hypersonic speeds. Hop Aero's goal is to provide the U.S. and allies the asymmetric advantage that deters a future major conflict.

name: PRINCEPS
line: AI-native insurance company for the compute economy
about: PRINCEPS is the first purpose-built insurance company for the trillion-dollar compute buildout. We underwrite SLA, GPU residual value, and outage risk, and price the coverage that unlocks cheaper financing for data centers and neoclouds.

name: Hebbian Robotics
line: Foundational infrastructure for Physical AI
about: Hebbian Robotics builds open source foundational infrastructure for Physical AI to develop robots that extend what humanity can do, for the benefit of the communities they serve.

name: Earendil Robotics
line: Drone swarm defence at a small-unit level
about: Earendil Robotics builds cUAS solutions for the modern warfighter, enabling effective air defence at the small-unit level. We deliver spotting, engaging, and destroying capabilities through advanced sensors, autonomous interceptors, and integrated systems. Our product lineup covers every stage of the kill chain, complemented by the Drone Warfare Academy that trains soldiers to eliminate enemy drone threats in contested environments. Backed by worldwide frontline combat experience, we equip units with combat-proven tools to counter evolving aerial threats.

name: Florin
line: Florin is an AI-native insurance company that runs autonomously
about: Florin is a full-stack insurance carrier where a model does the underwriting. When a submission comes in, Florin reads the ACORD forms, then investigates the risk on its own: satellite imagery, permits, public records, even the insured's Instagram, and catches exposures that never make it onto the application. It then simulates tens of thousands of ways the policy year could go, prices the risk, and returns a bindable quote in under a minute instead of weeks.

name: Locke
line: The First AI Government Affairs Firm.
about: Locke is the first AI-native government affairs firm. We pair elite lobbyists and political talent with our own AI systems, helping companies lobby policymakers and win government contracts. Locke's team comes from The White House, Congress, and the Pentagon.

name: Petrarch
line: Advancing model capabilities for critical infrastructure
about: Petrarch works with bankruptcy courts to source records from enterprises in the critical infrastructure sectors, then rigorously de-identifies and transforms the data into RL environments and tasks.

name: SpaceFlow Technologies, Inc.
line: AI-native procurement services for the physical economy
about: SpaceFlow is an AI-native procurement services company for businesses that make, move and serve physical goods. We help procurement teams bring more spend under management, execute source-to-contract work and turn identified savings into realized savings without adding headcount or replacing existing systems.

name: Ethos Space Resources
line: We make silicon on the Moon, to power everything in space.
about: Ethos makes silicon on the Moon to power terawatt scale data centers. The Moon's surface is 21% silicon. We melt and electrolyze the lunar surface to make raw materials for solar panels. With solar panels made from the Moon, the constraint that limits data center scaling and everything else in space is gone.

name: SubVysion
line: Autonomous rovers to make the ‘Google Maps’ of underground utilities
about: We build centimeter-accurate 3D maps of underground utilities to help construction contractors dig safer and faster. With underground intelligence, contractors can avoid dangerous utility strikes and costly project delays.

name: Avoca Systems
line: The AI operating system for radiology networks
about: Avoca is the AI patient access platform built for radiology. It integrates with a network’s existing systems and operational knowledge to automate calls, online scheduling, faxes, e-referrals and patient communications, from referral through to results and follow-up. Unlike generic scheduling tools, Avoca understands the clinical, operational and resource constraints behind every radiology booking, helping providers capture more demand, reduce administrative work and fill more scan capacity.

name: Tracer
line: Combining open-source AI models for better answers at lower cost
about: Tracer is an AI research lab building more capable and efficient AI through model coordination. We research adaptive inference, ensembling, and systems in which multiple open-source models work together to produce capabilities beyond any single model. Our work spans reasoning, code, research, and agentic systems, with the goal of making advanced intelligence more accessible and economical.

name: Wondering
line: Duolingo for learning anything
about: Wondering turns anything you want to learn, from LLMs to quantum mechanics to product design, into a path of three-minute lessons with visuals, podcasts, and interactive exercises. Each learning path and its content are personalized to your background, how you learn best, and how deep you want to go. It’s the most delightful way to understand complex topics and turn information into knowledge you can remember and apply. You don’t just passively read. You practice, make connections, and form your own insights. Start learning anything for free at https://wondering.app/download

name: HillStar
line: Agents to help utilities make better buying decisions.

name: Vernius Systems, Inc.
line: Mass-deployable radars for air defense
about: We make mass-deployable radars for unmanned systems. Our first product is Archimedes, a radar seeker that finds and locks onto targets, enabling autonomous intercept on any drone. We have over $580M in LOIs for Archimedes, across some of the largest defense primes in Ukraine, the EU, and the Middle East. Seekers are the most critical and costly component in every autonomous interceptor. Developing a radar seeker takes a 200+ person team at Raytheon and hundreds of millions of dollars.

name: OneCLI
line: AI teammates for your business-critical work.
about: OneCLI (YC S26) is an open-source platform for delegating business-critical work to AI agents, from Salesforce updates to data analysis and engineering investigations. Agents work across your company’s apps, prepare changes, and pause for approval when your rules require it. Your team controls what they can access and change, while credentials stay out of the agents’ reach and every call is logged. https://www.onecli.sh
where: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel

name: Nex
line: Grok bot for GTM & Revenue teams
about: We build and deploy AI agents that manage prospecting, qualification, CRM hygiene, forecasting, lead routing, revenue recovery, and all the complex revenue work in between, on autopilot.

name: Dawn Industries
line: Automatic Diagnosis & Fix for Industrial Automation Cells
about: VIM connects to the entire cell: PLCs, robots, CNC machines, sensors. When a cell faults, VIM finds the cause, stages the fix, and the operator approves with one click. When a part drifts, VIM catches it seconds after the cut, inside the machine, and recommends the correction. Recovery drops from 30 minutes to under two, saving more than $15,000 per fault in large factories.

name: CueBench
line: RL post-training for science reasoning and performance engineering

name: Autoresearch, Inc.
line: Autoresearch as a service: we solve your hardest measurable problems
about: Autoresearch helps teams train agents for tasks where general models are not good enough. Give us a task, your current agent or model, and an evaluation. Autoresearch runs an autoresearch campaign across data, SFT and other post-training methods, continual learning, prompts, tools, harnesses, and systems, then returns the best verified improvement. It runs hosted or in your cloud. We provide the research system around models: persistent memory, full experiment lineage, compute orchestration, and statistical verification.

name: Robocurve
line: Evals for robots
about: Robocurve builds open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure how well robots can do real-world jobs. Instead of relying on unverified demo videos from frontier labs, we score their models on reproducible benchmarks that anyone can trust. Today there are no well-run, standardized robotics benchmarks. Labs evaluate in-house, and no independent group has stepped in to run continuous benchmarking as a service. The result is that no one actually knows how good anyone else is, or where the real frontier sits.

name: Salem Robotics Inc
line: Deploying robots to replace workers in hazardous spaces
about: Our software turns any robot we deploy into an everyday independent worker at your facility. They are able to walk sites, handle instruments, overcome obstacles, collect measurements, and generate auditable compliance records, replacing hours of mandatory manual surveys and inspections. Built by Los Alamos robotics veterans and deterministic-manipulation researchers, we started in nuclear and are already expanding to other hazardous industries.

name: Allia Health
line: AI-Native Medical Group for Mental Health
about: Allia is the first full-stack, AI-native clinical group for mental health. We bring independent practices into one national clinical group that can deliver, measure, and improve care at scale .

name: Osseus
line: Data research lab for aligned health and biological AI
about: Osseus is building the frontier biomedical AI research lab, starting with the evaluations, reinforcement learning environments, and datasets that help AI labs train more capable, aligned, and safe models. We post-train models for medical and biological tasks, and deploy these in biotech, pharma and healthcare systems to ultimately improve patient outcomes.

name: hardware intelligence
line: make sense of silicon
about: Hardware Intelligence makes chip design tools to cut development by months. When a chip test fails, engineers need a recording of every internal signal called a waveform - but it can take days to generate and can be 100s of GB. Our breakthrough is WaveZip, which captures waveforms 8x faster and 500x smaller. We're also building Wavelength, an agentic telemetry layer. Using specialized ML models and a longitudinal history of WaveZip files, we're able to surface proactive insights never possible before.

name: Vorflux
line: A cloud-based AI coding agent for teams
about: Vorflux is a cloud-based AI coding agent for teams that takes work from an idea, ticket, or message through planning, implementation, review, testing, and a pull request. Its harness coordinates parallel agents, uses different models for planning and adversarial review, and retains codebase knowledge across sessions. Each team's repository and full stack run on dedicated compute, where QA agents test the application in a real browser and record video evidence.

name: Billow AI Labs
line: AI-native Accounting Firm that's killing Deloitte
about: Billow handles the work of Accounting and FP&A FTEs keeping teams compliant and audit-ready. We work within existing stacks (NetSuite, Coupa, and 80+ other systems) and complex spreadsheets, chasing down information and coordinating approvals across stakeholders. Built by repeat founders; Joan built and exited an accounting/ERP platform (45,000 businesses in 4 years) and Phil built Bloomberg's financial “brain” data infrastructure, and as CTO of a trading platform ($1B in volume). Advisors include CFOs, controllers, auditors from publicly-traded biopharma, and a Big-4 Accounting firm.

name: Atomarine
line: Floating nuclear powered data centers at sea.
about: We are building nuclear power delivery ships to power our floating compute barges at sea. Our systems are fully standalone, have better cooling, and avoid all the resource competition that leads to local community opposition. Our centralized manufacturing allows us to deploy anywhere on Earth, four times faster than on land.

name: Magma
line: Monetize your agent's traces.
about: We enable companies monetize their agents' traces.

name: Grep AI
line: Self-improving agents that automate your growth bottlenecks
about: Grep AI is the fastest way to create, optimize, and deploy agents for tedious, complex operational work that slows down your business. Our self-improving agents learn from every run, making them smarter and cheaper as you scale. IG.com a global retail brokerage used our agents to review compliance alerts and now 80% of their customers onboad without manual intervention, doubling first trades and propelling them to a FTSE 100 company.

name: Caution
line: Hosting platform for software you can't afford to have hacked
about: Caution is a hosting platform for software you can't afford to get hacked. It simplifies and extends confidential compute, and lets developers deploy workloads to secure enclaves in minutes and give customers, auditors, and counterparties cryptographic proof that production is running the exact reviewed source code, build, configuration, and runtime - not an opaque binary controlled by a cloud operator or internal admin. Confidential computing hardware exists, but the tooling is too fragmented and incomplete for most teams to use well.
where: George Town, George Town, Cayman Islands

name: Metalcraft
line: Advancing biological models
about: Metalcraft develops tasks that test how models analyze data, design experiments, and use evidence.

name: ernd
line: The Credit Card for the AI stack
about: ernd is the credit card for companies that pay for AI. We give 4% back on AI spend and partner with AI infrastructure companies to give cardholders extra perks, like 10% back on Wafer inference, 2x usage limits on Firecrawl and 62% off Trace pen tests. The card is live for US companies. In our first week, 30+ startups requested the card and we signed 8 partners. We combine experience in quant finance at Bridgewater and IMC, payments at Ripple, financial AI at Farsight, and founding an investment fund focused on distressed industrial acquisitions.

name: CoArena
line: The biggest crowdsourced benchmark for Computer-Use
about: CoArena is a live arena where anyone can use the world's top computer-use models racing two of them on the same real computer task and judging which one did it better. Every battle becomes something the AI labs can't build themselves, an honest test of their agents on real work, and the data to make them better.

name: Neomatter
line: AI harness that does all corporate legal work
about: Neomatter is a harness for in-house legal teams that integrates into communication channels like email and slack so it can complete the legal work before reaching the lawyer.

name: Edviro
line: AI That Operates Energy Infrastructure
about: Edviro builds AI that operates energy infrastructure. We connect to meters, HVAC systems, batteries, solar, and other energy equipment and continuously handle the work required to keep them efficient: detecting and diagnosing problems to forecasting demand, simulating fixes, creating work orders, coordinating maintenance, and controlling equipment where authorized. Our energy world models learn how each site behaves, choose the highest-value actions, and verify the results against real operational, meter, and billing data.

name: Experiential Labs
line: Open source AI gateway that turns your traffic into better models
about: We are building an open source gateway for AI budget holders to control model access and turn their traffic into better models that they own. We're a team that has earned an ML PhD at Georgia Tech, scaled AutoGPT to 160k GitHub stars, and led a self-driving simulation team at Waabi.

name: Simantic
line: Firmware simulation for AI agents
about: Simantic is modernizing the embedded firmware industry with hardware simulation developed for the adoption of AI in hardware engineering. Simantic gives both humans and AI the visibility into hardware previously limited by the physical world.

name: Conifer
line: Intelligent decisions for critical AI operations
about: AI now runs on a market of hundreds of models and providers that changes constantly, each with its own price, strengths and failure modes. Agents also act faster, and on more information, than people can meaningfully review. Conifer builds the decision layer between agents and the people in charge. Our gateway puts 240+ models from 28 providers behind one key, with 99.99% uptime. Our router picks a model for each request by weighing the task against its cost, and Parallax reviews the code agents write.

name: OpenTag
line: Model Agnostic AI coworker in Slack
about: OpenTag is an AI coworker in your Slack with full context on your company. It answers questions and takes real work off your plate. It also keeps your wiki up to date automatically, so knowledge never goes stale.

name: Voyager
line: Open harness for video and other creative work.
about: Most AI tools are built for coding. Voyager is designed to get the best creative results from models like Opus, Astra and DeepSeek. It comes bundled with free motion graphics, music and video editing tools - or, it can drive Blender, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Ableton and 100+ others. From the team behind Moda (moda.app, 100k+ users).

name: Runtime.si
line: Robots that think in simulation
about: Runtime is building a simulation-based robot policy that needs no fine-tuning or teleoperation.

name: Hue
line: Test agents in realistic worlds built from production usage
about: Hue turns production usage of agents into repeatable tests that preserve the tools, data, and state behind the real run. As AI agents take on real work, their behavior depends increasingly on the nuances of the world around them. With Hue, teams can test and improve their agents under conditions that mimic real usage.

name: herdr
line: building the open agent runtime
about: Developers don't run one coding agent anymore. They run fleets of them — for hours, sometimes days — across laptops, servers, and sandboxes. Keeping track of that work is the new bottleneck: which agent is blocked, which one finished, which terminal is it in, and why did everything die when the laptop closed. Herdr is the open-source home for that work. A background server owns the agents' terminal sessions on each machine, so the work survives disconnects, closed lids, and dropped SSH.

name: Summer Engine
line: The AI game engine.
about: Summer is where people and agents make, play and sell games. It's like Roblox and Unreal Engine, but made to let agents handle the busy work so you can focus on all the fun.

name: Theo
line: The site-builder and engine that gets your business found.
about: Theo is an AI agent that builds your small business website in minutes, then works on it every week so customers find you, whether they search Google themselves or ask an AI. Theo studies your site, your market and your search data, picks what will win the next customer, and ships it: a page for what people are searching for, a post that answers their question, or the fix that was holding you back.

name: Bayworks
line: Intelligence that keeps America’s vehicles running
about: Self-driving companies record every mile a car drives. Nobody records how it gets fixed. We capture how technicians fix cars and use it to run the dealership’s operations, making every repair faster and more consistent. In four months, we have gone from 0 to $843K in cARR across six dealership groups, including a top-50 US group ($3Bn annual revenue), and have powered over 50,000 repairs.

name: Sentient OS
line: On-device AI that knows your entire life and does your work overnight.
about: Truly personal AI requires running inference on your life, every day. In the cloud, that’s expensive and a privacy nightmare. On your own chip, it’s free and private. Our custom inference stack, built on a LiteRT-LM fork, runs on Macs with just 8 GB of RAM. Every night, Sentient’s on-device models process your emails, messages, Granola transcripts, files, and more, building a rich personal knowledge base on your Mac. Your projects, conversations, commitments, and preferences. Context you’d never have the time to type into a chatbot.

name: Simulithic
line: AI users that test your app on every device and browser
about: AI made writing code fast. Testing it is still slow. Simulithic sends AI users through your app on every device, browser and account type your customers use, so you can ship as fast as you can code, without writing or maintaining a single test.

name: Adalat AI
line: AI OS transforming courts, accelerating justice

name: ChemPilot.ai
line: Discover novel defense related materials/molecules.
about: ChemPilot accelerates the discovery and development of next generation defense materials using AI and data from our automated wet lab. Developing a new material today takes 10+ years of trial and error. We compress that to months by screening for what can actually be made, then closing the loop: every lab result feeds back into the models so the next round is faster and smarter. Sam, Ofir and Maor spent two years researching these materials at the Technion lab of our CSO, Prof. Alon Grinberg Dana (former MIT postdoc), working directly with defense primes and government R&D agencies.

name: Veeza AI
line: AI tourist visa agent for people with weak passports.
about: Billions of people need tourist visas to travel the world. We use AI agents to prepare applications, verify documents, secure appointments, and handle the visa process end to end.

name: Petrichor
line: Wet lab infrastructure that turns AI experiments into training data.
about: Real biology requires a wet lab, and building one takes years and a team most AI companies don't have. Petrichor runs their experiments at scale and sends back the dense, clean data their models need to learn from.

name: Kailash Labs
line: A factory for small and specialized video reasoning models
about: The world generates petabytes of video every day, and almost none of it is readable to machines. Frontier VLMs that can unlock this (like Gemini) are too expensive to run at the volume real industries have, too generic for any single task, and can't be deployed on-prem where sensitive video lives. We are building an auto vision factory: take video plus a customer's objective, distill a frontier model, and post-train a small open model that is SOTA on that one task and serve it blazingly fast.

name: Reific
line: RL environments for superhuman reasoning over time
about: Reific builds RL environments for superhuman reasoning over time, for the frontier labs that train agents. AI has learned to reason over text and code. But most of what matters in the real world shows up as numbers that change every second: a heartbeat, a gearbox, a GPU cluster. No human can track thousands of signals at once, but AI should be able to. In our environments, data streams in on a clock while the agent works, and every action is graded by what actually happened. Most AI training today teaches models to match human experts. We treat human performance as the floor.

name: Topos
line: Agent swarms
about: Topos is a neolab founded by two Harvard math dropouts, building agent swarms to bring the rigor and verifiability of mathematics to other fields. Starting in biology, we’re optimizing how agents communicate, formalize problems, and verify each other’s reasoning.

name: Saccade
line: World's Earliest Test for Alzheimer's Biomarkers
about: Alzheimer's testing today is bottlenecked around the onset of symptoms, when the damage is already done. Current treatments, including the FDA-approved drugs released in 2024, don't reverse the disease; they only slow it down. Earlier detection means earlier intervention. Eye movement changes linked to Alzheimer's surface sooner than any other biomarker, up to 15 years before symptoms appear.

name: Agent 37
line: Cloud Sandbox for Agents
about: * Ready to Use Instantly: Skip the complex server setup. It comes pre loaded with top AI Agents (like Claude Code and Hermes) so your agents can start working immediately. * Keep Your Work Safe: Unlike other systems that delete everything when they finish a task, these sandboxes remember your files, code, and settings forever until you delete them. * Pay Only for What You Use: Stop paying for idle servers. You pay a tiny fee to store your files, but you only pay for compute power during the exact minutes your AI is actively running.

name: OpenScaffold
line: Superagent for Deployment Teams
about: OpenScaffold is building AGI for every deployment team. The result is a custom scaffold that is autonomously harnessed for each deployment, drawn from customer discovery, business objectives, past deployments, and more.

name: Faraday
line: Industrial aOS coordinating humans, agents, and machines
about: Industrial and legacy enterprises still rely on people to coordinate disconnected layers of software and machines. Automating this work has required an FDE services approach in the past, because so much of it is bespoke and company specific. Faraday is a self-improving platform that take on this operational work. It connects to their existing software and machines and automatically builds training environments around each company’s workflows and data. Each job the agents do is checked against those environments, and the results are used to train them.

name: AnyAlpha
line: The agentic trading platform
about: AnyAlpha is the agentic trading platform. It turns your trading idea into an agent that trades it for you, 24/7. Start with an idea. AnyAlpha builds the agent on institutional-grade data, backtests it on historical data, and trades it live on multiple exchanges. We're starting with prediction markets, with more asset classes to follow. We signed Kalshi’s first and only partnership for agentic trading. AnyAlpha has reached 1,000+ active traders and over $1M in weekly trading volume since we launched trading in October.

name: SE3 Labs
line: Real-World RL Environments for Physical AI
about: We build real-world RL environments for robots. Starting with tasks from industry partners, we test policies on real robots and identify where they fail. We use those failures to decide what data to collect and curate for the next policy update. Next, we're setting up physical sandboxes at partner sites, so policies can train on the exact tasks and conditions they'll face in deployment.

name: Letter
line: The world's first coding agent, IDE & infra for growth engineering.
about: The Letter Company issues autonomous pull requests to scale websites, agent experiences, and so much more. Today, we solve modern issues like agentic conviction, inbound conversion, SEO, GEO, etc. However, we believe as agents become more truth-seeking, spammy marketing strategies will fall apart in favor of benchmark and evidence-based messaging. These are engineering problems that only a purpose-built coding agent can solve.

name: Outworld Labs
line: Robotics simulation indistinguishable from reality
about: Outworld Labs is building a simulation platform for training and evaluating robot foundation models. The platform is built on a brand new physics engine designed from the ground up for dexterous manipulation. It enables researchers to easily create realistic environments, reconstruct and augment real-world data, and improve their models through large-scale simulation without the cost of physical robots and real-world data collection.

name: Viraj Aero
line: Next generation gas turbines for data centers & aviation
about: Viraj Aero builds gas turbines that deliver both power and cooling water for data centers. It needs no grid connection and no water pipeline. Burning natural gas already produces water. Our patented system captures that water from the exhaust. Part of it cools the data center. The rest is turned into steam and injected back into the turbine. That gives up to 40% more power from the same fuel (cheaper compute) and cuts NOx emissions by up to 99%, which cuts permit approvals from years to weeks. We're building a genset around our first-of-its-kind gas turbine.

name: Orgo
line: Computers for Agents
about: Orgo is the simplest way to give your AI employees their own secure, persistent cloud computers. Over 1000 teams use Orgo to run AI workers.

name: Boat
line: The best cloud VMs for billions of agents
about: **Problem** Humans used to need laptops to do their work. Now they prompt agents instead, and those agents need computers too: always-on, in large quantities, and with unlimited capabilities. Building and maintaining that yourself is far from trivial. **Solution** Boat provides powerful, simple, permissive Ubuntu VMs in the cloud. In a sandbox, an agent can work for long periods on code or on knowledge work like legal, research, reporting, and auditing. **Why Boat and not any other cloud VM?** 1.

name: Applied Kinetics
line: AI-native manufacturing for data center and energy projects
about: Applied Kinetics is an AI-native, end-to-end manufacturer for data center and energy developers. We supply the transformers, switchgear, generators, cooling systems, and other critical equipment needed to bring new power and compute capacity online. Every unit is built to project specifications, and we manage the process from technical requirements through production and delivery.
