We shorten lead times and accelerate projects forward, removing the physical bottlenecks holding back the next generation of technological progress.

name: Inflection Space Systems
line: Hyperscaling space manufacturing
about: Inflection is building the industrial capacity to manufacture tens of thousands of spacecraft per year for next generation commercial and government space applications. Imagine a factory that looks like an Amazon fulfillment center instead of a NASA clean room.

name: Capveon
line: Turning infrastructure demand into action

name: Ample Computer
line: Everything your agent needs to ship a web app
about: Cloud hosting and infrastructure platform that has everything your agent needs to ship web applications. We set up compute, frontend, database, storage, CDN, email and (soon) text, analytics, and payments. We then monitor, patch and scale your app so you never migrate anything again. We're doing for the internet software economy what Shopify did for e-commerce - remove the technical barriers to anyone can launch anything.

name: Aviern
line: Unmanned cargo airplanes
about: Aviern makes unmanned cargo airplanes for commercial operations and defense logistics. In 2 months we built our own scaled aircraft that taxis, takes off, flies and lands fully autonomously and are working on a larger 50lb aircraft.

name: Forward
line: The private credit network for leading debt advisors
about: Founded in 2026, Forward is a San Francisco-based technology company, connecting private credit funds with exclusive loan opportunities, sourced from leading debt advisors across America.

name: Taan.ai
line: the most precise & controllable foundation music models
about: Taan builds foundation music models that do what you tell them to, when you tell them to. We're starting with music for video. Give Taan a video and it watches it, then composes an original score that follows the emotion and timing of every cut. If the scene is tense for 10 seconds and then turns happy, the music changes at that exact moment. You get back a fully mixed .mp4. Agents and apps call Taan through our API, so any video tool can add scored, synced music with one call. Today's music models can make catchy tracks, but you can't steer them.

name: Stacktrace
line: Give agents autonomy without losing control
about: Agents will do most of the work in the future, but only if teams can trust them unsupervised. Stacktrace is the control layer for every agent: it sees every action, detects risky behavior, enforces the bounds your team sets, and steps in when an agent drifts from intent.

name: Altair Health
line: Stripe for medical billing
about: Altair is an AI-native medical billing service for independent practices. We take over a practice's billing end to end and get doctors paid by insurers. AI does the work; our billers handle the exceptions. That can only work if a practice can trust an agent alone with its revenue. So we formalized insurers' billing policies and put a theorem prover under the agent. Before the agent acts on a claim, the prover checks the action against that insurer's policies, and anything that fails goes to one of our billers.

name: Armorer Labs
line: Continuous security verification for AI in regulated industries
about: Armorer helps companies in regulated industries ship their own AI systems faster and keep them secure in production. Most security tools flag an issue and file a ticket. Armorer assesses your agent and simulates attacks to find the real issues. Then it creates a verified fix that stops the attack without breaking the business, ready for your approval in about 4 hours. In production, Armorer checks every agent action in milliseconds, with no GPU needed. It detects malicious behavior such as prompt injection, goal hijacking and data leaks, then allows, holds or denies the action.

name: Rhem Labs
about: Rhem Labs builds smart home care devices that help older adults and people with complex care needs live independently.

name: Talos
line: Predictive maintenance for power infrastructure.
about: At Talos, we are building better, more modern predictive maintenance for the power industry with a focus on large transformers. Our devices continuously monitor critical power equipment and detect problems early on using anomaly-detection models. For each fault, we provide detailed analyses of the problem, exactly where and why it happened, as well as next steps teams should take.

name: Nitroduck
line: Monsanto for yummy crops, but without pesticides
about: We make gene editing easy for all crops. To make pesticides obsolete across vegetables and fruits, enabling coffee to withstand heat waves, making almonds independent of pollinators, pistachios independent of winter chill, and much more. To let breeders create novel, consumer-facing crop varieties like pink pineapples, seedless cherries, and non-browning avocados.

name: Lantern AI
line: Agentic Recruiting Platform for Enterprise
about: Lantern is the agentic recruiting platform for enterprise. Traction: $1M ARR, 30% MoM growth, 230% NDR. Clients include Hyatt, Baker McKenzie, Crypto.com, etc. Lantern runs on: (1) World People Model, a live talent graph of a billion professionals that knows who’s exceptional, reachable, and about to move (2) Company Hiring Model, which learns your taste from every hiring decision you’ve ever made Together, our agents plug into your existing systems and run the whole workflow: sourcing, application review, AI interviews, meeting intelligence, and analytics, under universal context.

name: Munito AI
line: Open-model inference provider for Europe, private by default.
about: Munito is an open-model inference provider for Europe, private by default. Its API lets users choose their models and keep inference and storage in the EU. Founded by the former inference lead at Mistral AI, Munito is built on one belief: open and independent intelligence, both models and inference, is key to economic growth and prosperity.

name: OpenLake Technologies
line: OpenLake lets companies deploy models that improve in real time
about: OpenLake is a real time inference platform which improves your model quality in real time. Plug in your datasets, RL environments and conversations. Get the intelligence your company deserves without needing an AI research lab. Pick an open model like Kimi K3 or GLM 5.3 and deploy it in one click. OpenLake keeps your model upto date with real time data sources, so the model you run tomorrow is more accurate than the last. OpenLake serves 100B+ tokens a day.

name: Micora
line: Micro-grids in a box deploying industrial power autonomously in weeks
about: Micora re-designed the process of building solar farms to optimize speed to power generation and portability. The product suite combines a palletized solar block, a containerized energy storage system, and low-cost autonomous robots that deploy a solar farm on-site in days to weeks – and pack it back up when needed.

name: horizontal.
line: AI agents that run factory operations end-to-end.
about: Every factory will be run by AI agents. Horizontal is building them. Today, the work that keeps production moving is scattered across people, teams, and disconnected software. When plans change, materials run short, or quality issues appear, factory teams piece together the context and coordinate the response by hand. Horizontal's AI agents take on that operational work inside the systems factories already use. They replan production around a disruption, investigate quality issues and coordinate order releases across teams and tools.

name: Nodus Compute
line: Maximize the AI you get from your Infrastructure
about: GPU capacity is sold like real estate: locked up, prepaid and idle half the time. Nodus makes it liquid, runs any AI workload on it through one execution layer, and puts research agents on every run to make the next one cheaper. More workloads mean better research, and better research means cheaper compute, a loop no single-product cloud can match.

name: Mirrors
line: Fix recurring AI agent mistakes with real-time guidance
about: Production AI agents keep making the same mistakes. The usual fix is another line in the system prompt. Over time, the agent carries instructions for dozens of situations, even when it’s doing something simple, and every correction becomes another thing to maintain. Mirrors lets developers maintain production agents by turning recurring mistakes into targeted corrections. It surfaces recurring mistakes across production runs. Developers write a correction, choose the situations where it applies, and preview its scope against past conversations.

name: OpenCrawl
line: Multiplayer for your coding agents.
about: OpenCrawl is an open-source platform that lets AI coding agents work as a team. Engineering teams now run many agents at once, across Claude Code, Codex, laptops, and cloud environments. Each one works alone, so engineers spend their time moving context between agents and cleaning up duplicated work and conflicting changes. OpenCrawl gives every agent your team runs a shared memory and a way to talk to each other. Agents can search what other agents have already done and decided, and coordinate their work as it happens.

name: Asakana
line: Automating away manual admin for food distributors: texts to ERP
about: Restaurants send orders to food distributors by email, text, and photo. Someone at the distributor retypes every one of them into the ERP. Asakana does that entry instead: orders land in the ERP already entered, and anything unclear goes to a person before it goes in. Live at US seafood distributors today, returning 40%+ of order-desk time to selling. Founded by a seafood distributor and a Gemini builder.

name: Perceptual Labs
line: Building intelligence that can understand and rewrite itself

name: River
line: The AI computer.
about: AI made software engineers 100x more productive. We're doing the same thing for knowledge work with the AI computer.

name: Hopper
line: The Inference cloud for voice
about: We are building the inference layer for voice. Voice agents are latency-sensitive and differentiated enough to warrant a focused inference player, similar to Fal (inference for video) or Sail Research (inference for long horizon agents). Before this our team wrote megakernels at Meta Reality Labs and ran inference at Salient (a16z-backed voice startup)

name: TrueMile
line: The AI-native trucking company
about: TrueMile is building an AI-native trucking company. We run our own fleet, using agents to find freight, plan loads, and coordinate drivers and brokers. Our goal is to reduce empty miles, improve truck utilization, and lower the cost of moving goods. Operating the fleet ourselves lets us connect each decision to its outcome on the road and improve how we work. We’re starting with human drivers. As autonomous trucks become available on our routes, we intend to put them to work within an established freight network.

name: ByteAsk
line: The AI coding agent for C and C++
about: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent built for C and C++, the code that runs trading systems, cars, chips, and operating systems. It does not stop at a diff that looks right. ByteAsk builds, debugs, and tests every change with the real toolchain until the change holds. If the compiler, the debugger, or the tests can catch it, then ByteAsk catches it too. It runs from the terminal or inside VS Code, Neovim, and Emacs, and is available fully on-prem.

name: Antropi Robotics
line: Autonomous CNC factories for faster hardware

name: Elimentary
line: Agents that run middle/back-office operations for Private Capital
about: Elimentary’s is building AI agents that can run middle/back-office operations for private capital managers, starting with structured credit. Most private capital managers focus primarily on sourcing and capital deployment. Meanwhile post-investment operations receive step-child treatment. While AUMs have increased exponentially over the last decade, operations continue to be painfully supported by humans using spreadsheets and emails. Things have started to break leading to investment write-offs, fines, penalties, and sometimes lost LP relationships.

name: Agent Relay
line: Let your teams' coding agents message each other
about: Agent Relay lets software teams' AI coding agents message each other directly, so people stop copy/pasting between Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and their teammates' agents. A frontend agent can ask the backend agent what an API returns, two agents can sort out a merge conflict between themselves, and your agent can answer a colleague's agent while you sleep. Agents connect wherever they run: terminals, desktop apps, phones, laptops, cloud boxes, or a Mac mini across the world. Every session goes into shared, searchable history, so decisions don't get stuck in one person's chat.

name: Helios Intelligence
line: At-home molecular body test: 1,000+ biomarkers from a drop of blood
about: Helios is building a molecular body test from a single drop of blood. Our at-home test measures more than 1,000 biomarkers and turns them into a living model of the body—designed to show what is happening now, surface risk earlier, and become more useful with every test. By combining longitudinal molecular data with labs, wearables, health records, and outcomes, we are building toward a world model of human biology. Our goal is to simulate all of human health and use that intelligence to help people perform, recover, and live longer.

name: Invertix
line: AI agents that operate energy plants and datacenters
about: Invertix builds AI that helps energy companies run Power Plants Autonomously. We believe Power Plants and Datacenters will be autonomously developed and operated. We are building that AI layer. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0uDH6pMn5OE Critical Infrastructure is a $10 trillion market.

name: Raven
line: A new phone rebuilt around agents: more done, less time on screen.
about: Phones were made to run apps. Raven is made for the world of agents. It is where you send your agents from, and where they report back. Pre-order at ravenphone.com

name: Open Actuation
line: Quick-turn, purpose-built motors & actuators for all
about: We design and manufacture high-mix drone motors and robotic actuators in LA. DJI, Apple, and Ford don't settle for OTS components. Likewise, the teams that win the Western robotics market will build seamless machines from tightly integrated software and hardware. Open Actuation designs motors and actuators around your robot's unique form factor and mission - then we rapidly bring them to life with proprietary software and tooling geared for high-mix machining and assembly.

name: Dydema
line: A consumer brain-computer interface you can map to anything.
about: We’re building a brain-computer interface anyone can wear, so you can use a computer at the speed of thought. To get there, we’re recording brain data at model company scale.

name: Plek AI
line: The AI company brain for PE value creation
about: Plek is the AI company brain for private equity value creation. Upload an employee census, and Plek maps every person to a taxonomy of 50,000 jobs and 250,000 tasks, down to the time each task takes. It then analyzes spans and layers, org structure, footprint, compensation, functional fragmentation and AI exposure in parallel, and reconciles overlapping levers employee by employee so every dollar is traceable. What takes a performance improvement team 6 to 8 weeks takes Plek under a minute.

name: Repovive
line: Scaling AI formal verification for chips and critical software
about: We work with AI labs to improve models on formal verification. We have $100k in contracts across two math formalization RL environments and a $200k LOI for our broader coding data. Our team includes IOI and ICPC medalists, PhDs, and ex-Google engineers. We’ve published papers at leading AI conferences, including NeurIPS, ICLR, and IJCAI. We’ve formed the densest community cluster of 12,000 IMO, IOI, and ICPC medalists.

name: Workers IO
line: Simulation environments for verifying mission-critical software
about: Workers IO is building simulation environments to catch failures in mission-critical software before they reach production. We run your entire system through millions of simulated production scenarios to verify its correctness and performance properties. Coding agents can now generate code faster than teams can review it. Meanwhile, software and the infrastructure it runs on keep getting more complex. Tests check a small set of cases in isolation, in environments that are different from production. Some of the most expensive failures only surface when customers encounter them.

name: Oasive
line: Credit research for municipal bond analysts
about: Oasive gives bond investors the data, models and research to decide what to buy. For muni credit analysts, Oasive brings a borrower's audited financials, debt, board meetings and local news into one page built around what matters for that sector, with every number linked to its source. Before a fund buys a bond from a city, school district, hospital or airport, that's the information its analyst has to dig up by hand from PDFs on local websites, board minutes and local news.

name: Quivly AI
line: AI agents that run onboarding, adoption, and renewals
about: Quivly is the agentic workspace for everything after the sale. Our agents turn kickoff calls into launch plans, chase blockers, catch risk and expansion signals, and have the full account story ready at renewal. With Quivly, companies are able to take their customers live in 7 days instead of 30, and then grow revenue from these customers by 4.3x on avg.

name: Ordo Labs
line: Regulated lab software, rebuilt around AI agents
about: Ordo lets regulated labs delegate analysis, quality checks and report drafting to AI agents. We turn each lab’s checking rules into workflows, with source-linked results for scientists to review and approve. We have two paid pilots with labs in the US and Europe. Pilot results show 90%+ less time spent on post-analysis work. Our ambition is to make lab software perform more of the work scientists currently do manually, expanding across analytical methods, report types and sites. Agents do the work, scientists sign.

name: Praxis
line: AI agents that run law firm operations.
about: At Praxis, we’ve built AI agents that run law firm operations, from first inquiry to paid invoice. Agents do the admin end to end, and the lawyer supervises and approves every step. Firms reply in minutes, onboard clients in days instead of weeks, and spend their time practicing law. Lawyers spend 62% of their day on admin nobody pays for: intake, conflict checks, chasing documents, engagement letters, follow-ups, billing. Every hour on admin is an hour a client waits, and clients go to the firm that answers first.

name: Shepherd Robotics
line: Robots for high skilled labor powering AI infrastructure
about: Shepherd Robotics builds general purpose robots for skilled physical work across AI infrastructure and advanced manufacturing. Our robots are powered by robot foundation models and use modular, flexible hardware designed to adapt to different environments and tasks. We train our systems on a combination of real world and simulation data so they can learn complex manipulation skills and generalize across workflows.

name: Deploy
line: The generalist robot deployment company.
about: Deploy's core belief is that robots should be useful. Getting a generalist robot to do real work is fundamentally the same problem across industries. We build everything between the model and the task to bring generalist robots to the businesses that actually need them.

name: Lucebox
line: Self-improving inference workstation
about: Lucebox makes workstations for local AI inference. They're private, always-on machines that arrive with Lucebox's inference engine installed and tuned, so developers point Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode on their own hardware. Lucebox is building toward a new category of self-improving personal AI computers that learn from the work you do every day, training small models on your own context until they're faster and better than the cloud at your tasks. The engine is open source, with 2.9K stars on GitHub and 95K+ downloads on Hugging Face.

name: Kairox Systems
line: Autonomous drones that fly and swim
about: Kairox Systems combines the speed of aerial drones and the stealth of underwater drones into one vehicle. We can look for mines in a strait, fly out of the water to inspect a coastline, and then engage maritime threats in one go. Joel, Alex, and Jorge all met at MIT. After conversations with warfighters and drone researchers, they decided to create a vehicle unlike any before: A long-range vehicle that is truly amphibious, low-cost enough for one-way swarms, can operate fully autonomously, and can be repurposed on the front lines.

name: Caladh
line: Anti-drone defense for the maritime domain
about: Caladh protects critical maritime infrastructure from drone attacks above and below the waterline. Our systems detect, track, and defeat unmanned systems so they can't get near the assets they want to disrupt.

name: Streamline Systems
line: Precision navigation for UAVs operating without GPS.
about: Streamline Systems is building the replacement for GPS. Satellite positioning has become the single point of failure for almost every modern system, both military and civil. We've built the replacement. A drop-in module that integrates with existing Ardupilot, INAV and PX4 flight controllers, with demonstrated satellite-independent autonomous flight and GPS handoff. We have secured over $80k in contracted revenue to supply our navigation modules for the Pentagon's $1.1bn Drone Dominance Program.

name: Evardi
line: Agents that engineer the grid edge
about: At least 94% of US outage minutes start on the distribution grid, and most utilities are blind between the substation and the meter. Evardi builds a live model of a utility’s network from data it already has, matching every meter to its transformer and using virtual meters to show load and solar on every transformer. On top of that model, our AI agents do the engineering work utilities need at the grid edge: checking switching orders, finding outages after extreme weather and planning for new load from DERs and data centers.

name: ORO AI
line: RL environments & simulations for autonomous businesses.
about: ORO AI is an applied AI research lab. We build high-fidelity simulation environments grounded in real data to teach AI the tacit knowledge required to run safe and profitable autonomous businesses. Our first public benchmark, SMB Bench, puts a frontier model in charge of a produce wholesaler's buying desk for a simulated 90-day quarter, where shortages and supplier failures have delayed effects.

name: Hemlock
line: Force + contact dynamics collected at scale for training physical AI.
about: At Hemlock, we equip workers around the globe with EMG wearables to generate force/contact-annotated egocentric video data to give physical AI models a sense of touch from human data. Force + contact dynamics, collected at scale.

name: twentyfour26
line: Building Autonomous Factories in America, Starting with On-Demand CNC…
about: At twentyfour26, we are developing standardized manufacturing cells that bring machines, tooling, workholding, and inspection under a single system. Our models are being developed to interpret CAD designs, plan machining strategies, select tooling and setups, and operate the machines. We're already manufacturing components for hardware companies in and around the Bay Area, with turnaround times as fast as ~48 hours. Operating our own machines allows us to develop and deploy automation against real production workloads.

name: HyperBench
line: AI agents for hardware/software co-development
about: An agentic engineering platform for hardware and software co-development, with specialized AI agents that understand your system, work across repositories, and verify their changes on real hardware.

name: Orca Aerospace
line: AI spacecraft operators that live onboard the vehicle
about: At Orca, we are focused on creating the future of spacecraft operations by moving control onto the vehicle. By allowing AI models to control the satellite using deterministic tooling, we are able to achieve the same holistic, high-quality decisions on "what" to do to carry out a mission while maintaining the safety of systems that decide "how" to execute it.

name: Fleety
line: Fleety is an AI dispatcher for plumbing and HVAC companies.
about: A typical customer handles 100+ jobs a day, with their best technician generating $500,000 more revenue than the average. Fleety listens to every call and automatically routes each job to the technician most likely to generate the most revenue.

name: 0.security
line: The autonomous cybersecurity team
about: 0.security builds an autonomous offensive security team that finds and fixes vulnerabilities as fast as AI writes code and before attackers exploit them. We've found and fixed dozens of previously unknown vulnerabilities (0-days) in government software across multiple countries and in software running on 3+ billion devices. Today we work with EY (Ernst & Young), leading tech companies and defense organizations. Our AI agents hack into any software, verify every vulnerability they find, and ship the fix.

name: Plover Labs
line: Enable enterprises to ship agent code without human review
about: Plover Labs is building toward a future where AI agents write, ship, and maintain most of a company's software. We make it possible for agents to own real engineering roles, not just suggest code for someone else to approve. Coding models keep getting more capable, but enterprise adoption lags behind AI-native startups because enterprises don't yet trust agent output. Each codebase has conventions, history, and failure modes that a general-purpose model doesn't know. We learn those continuously from the code, how the team works, and the mistakes agents make.

name: Ploid
line: The people data company for the agent era
about: Ploid is the AI-native people data infrastructure for developers and companies building products, workflows, and agents around people. We've built an index of 2B+ people across professional and social sources, giving developers one API to search for people, enrich profiles, find emails and phone numbers, resolve identities, and retrieve up-to-date information from across the web. Unlike traditional people databases built around static records, Ploid combines its massive people index with real-time retrieval and identity resolution, delivering fresh, reliable information whenever it's needed.

name: Primordiant
line: Embodied Scientific Intelligence
about: Every instance of intelligence occurring in nature is embodied. Scientific intelligence is no different. We are building general-purpose robotic experimentalists: systems that unite scientific reasoning and physical action to iterate toward discovery by observing, hypothesizing and experimenting.

name: Obia
line: AI-native commercial real estate brokerage
about: OBIA is an AI-native commercial real estate brokerage for industrial and office. We help businesses find their best-fit space, negotiate a competitive deal backed by market data, and get the keys in as little as two weeks. Finding the right space means evaluating operational fit, zoning, and pricing using information scattered across listings, brochures, municipal codes, maps, and broker conversations. That research can take a broker hours per property. OBIA reduces that work to minutes.

name: Rystic
line: Train models and test agents in high-fidelity simulated environments

name: Vorelios
line: AI that can engineer anything
about: Vorelios is a research lab developing AI that understands physics and engineers autonomously, from an objective to the system that achieves it. We want to turn humanity's greatest ambitions into tractable engineering problems, accelerate the technologies that transform civilization, and discover the ones no one has imagined yet.

name: Dreamscale Labs
line: Real-time cloud inference for robotics.
about: Dreamscale Labs is building the fastest cloud inference platform for robotics. As complex physical AI models become difficult to fit on expensive on-robot GPUs, we let users offload inference to the cloud and serve them with real-time latency. So far, we've hit 40-50% lower latency than existing neoclouds.

name: Halmos Labs
line: Rebuilding drug development for automation
about: The drug development pipeline is built around humans. Other AI biotech companies build automation around the established infrastructure. Halmos Labs rebuilds the infrastructure around automation. The central bottleneck is access to experiments. Halmos Labs platform physicalvalidation.com connects agents to biolabs across the globe in days rather than weeks. Using physicalvalidation.com, Halmos research agent is continuously designing drugs and has so far designed and tested a new mRNA cancer vaccine and a new antibiotic with results December 10th.

name: Verno
line: AI engineering industrials like chip fabs, refineries and power plants
about: Every refinery, chip fab and power plant is built from thousands of engineering documents that are supposed to agree, and engineers still keep them in sync by hand. Verno is AI for how the physical world gets built. An engineer describes a change, and Verno edits the P&ID in the native CAD file, carries the change through line lists and other downstream documents, and checks every one against engineering rules before the engineer approves it. On drawings already issued for construction, it has caught errors like one tank with three different design pressures across three documents.

name: Resin Technologies
line: Resin helps engineers design electronics faster and more reliably
about: Resin is an AI-native ECAD tool. It lets engineers: - research designs - generate schematics - generate any symbols/footprints - route simple to complex boards

name: Routant
line: Last mile deployment and connectivity for Agents as a Service
about: AI agents won’t stay inside the companies that build them. The most valuable agents will work across company boundaries, inside customers’ private systems. In those environments, intelligence is no longer the barrier to deployment. Trust and access are. Routant is the zero-trust access layer for this new agentic world. Vendors integrate once, while customers retain governance over every deployment, deciding what agents can access and which actions need human review, with a complete audit trail of every action.

name: Telamont
line: Sentry for errors in construction documents
about: Telamont catches contractual, technical and code-compliance risks in construction documents and gives teams the system to act on them before they become costly rework or disputes. Construction projects lose money in the gap between what the documents say and what gets built. One missed discrepancy between the specs, drawings, geotechnical study and code can become a seven-figure claim eighteen months later. Telamont connects to where your documents live and pulls in every file and revision as it lands, continuously building a complete picture of the project.

name: Ignition Benefits
line: The AI-Native Benefits Brokerage
about: Ignition is an AI-native employee benefits brokerage for companies with under 200 employees. Health insurance is one of the largest line items these companies carry, and employers absorb 15 to 40% rate increases year after year without ever seeing their own numbers. We have rebuilt the sales and back office to be AI-first. This market represents about $500B of market cap, and those businesses have not fundamentally changed in over 50 years.

name: Pomerado
line: Turn any website into an MCP for your agents, in minutes
about: Pomerado turns any website into an API / MCP in minutes. Connect your agents to legacy portals, consumer websites, and internal tools. Why Pomerado: • 7x faster than browser agents on customer workflows • 100x cheaper than browser agents • Self healing, deterministic APIs • Universal website coverage • Hosting, authentication, and permissions handled Customers can use us to: • automate back office workflows on legacy systems (ERP, EHR, CRM) • speed up customer integrations for forward deployments • connect enterprise assistants to internal tools • supercharge personal assistants with fast and…

name: Archgen Labs
line: AI-powered EDA tools for faster, cooler 3D chips
about: Archgen Labs builds AI-powered chip design tools for the next generation of 3D semiconductors. Stacking compute vertically shortens connections and reduces the energy and delay of moving data. But it also makes heat harder to remove. Our tools help engineers optimize placement, timing, and temperature together so they can build faster, more power-efficient 3D chips. Our GPU-accelerated placement engine ranked first in the Hudson River Trading macro-placement challenge.

name: Polemos Industries
line: AI-guided ballistic missiles, built for mass manufacturing
about: Precision strike is rationed. Forces see more targets than they can afford to hit. Polemos builds AI-guided ballistic missiles and the compact launchers that fire them, designed for mass manufacturing. Our launchers form a strike network wired into the recon drones already in the sky: a drone geolocates a target, the nearest launcher fires, and a guided round lands in seconds. Short range, no wasted kilometers, no modified trucks. Built on production lines that already exist, so output scales when it matters most.

name: Organizely
line: A New AI-Native ERP for American Manufacturers 🇺🇸
about: Organizely helps American manufacturers use AI to lower production costs. Factories depend on three resources: materials, equipment, and labor. Costs rise unexpectedly when components are missing, machines go down, or staffing doesn’t match demand. We experienced this firsthand while owning and operating a factory in the U.S. for six years. As we scaled, it was expensive to resolve factory-wide bottlenecks quickly and it became harder to stay competitive on price.

name: Covera
line: Covera gets insurance brokers to quote first and win more business.
about: Insurance is one of the last big industries still running on manual work. Trillions in premium flow through brokers who still have to key the same data into their agency management system (AMS), chase clients for documents, and fill one carrier portal after another. Every hour spent on manual quoting is an hour not spent selling. Across tens of thousands of brokers, that's billions in revenue left on the table. Software never fixed it, because the work sits between systems and raters are outdated.

name: Hesper AI
line: AI Claims Investigator for Insurance
about: Hesper AI builds AI agents that investigate P&C insurance claims end to end. Hesper’s agents read the claim file, detect tampered documents, verify facts, check coverage, flag inconsistencies, and produce an audit-ready case file in minutes, so insurers can check every claim. We work with Claims and SIU orgs at Carriers, MGAs and TPAs,

name: EveryApp
line: Making every SaaS open source
about: EveryApp is building open source alternatives to every SaaS. It’s a platform to host these open source apps and personal software. Everything runs behind one secure sign-in in your own Cloudflare account.

name: Particularity
line: Building the tech stack for government regulators
about: Agentic case sourcing: proactively find violations of consumer protection statutes in public data and prepackage cases for regulators

name: Reconero
line: Reconero helps police officers automate their workflows with AI
about: Officers join the force to protect their communities, yet over 40% of their day is eaten by paperwork that keeps them behind a desk. The burden reaches beyond lost time. Burnout is driving officers out of the force, leaving those who remain carrying an even heavier workload. Reconero is built to give that time back. By automating reports, forms, analytics, and more, we help officers finish their administrative paperwork faster, spend more time serving their communities, and protect the time they have with their families.

name: Vexo
line: An AI bracelet that remembers your day and acts before you ask.
about: Vexo is an Always listening AI bracelet. that remembers everything you say and hooks up to your existing AI agents that you can control from your wrist.

name: Archangel Health
line: Infra to make AI safe enough to practice medicine
about: Archangel Health builds the infrastructure to post-train and evaluate medical AI: RL environments inside real de-identified EHRs, physician-verified training data, and benchmarks that test clinical reasoning on hard cases. Frontier labs and medical AI companies use it today, and we're now moving toward post-training open-source models for health systems on their own data and their own physicians' judgment

name: Yam
line: AI-powered romance sims for women
about: Yam simulates a Love Island–style dating experience for women, starring their favorite characters. Avg playtime per DAU is 3+ hrs!

name: Ailit
line: Electrifying North American freight rail with swappable batteries.
about: Ailit is building the electric energy system for North American freight rail. Our first product, Superwagon, is a battery wagon designed to power existing diesel-electric locomotives, allowing railroads to electrify the fleets they already own. Superwagon carries swappable battery packs that supply electricity to the locomotive’s existing electric motors. Discharged packs are exchanged for charged ones along the route and recharged off-board, providing operators with limitless range. We deliver energy as a service, owning and operating the batteries and swapping sites.

name: Native
line: Instinct for marketing
about: Native is building an autonomous marketing platform where business can do all of their marketing within one platform using our artificial intuition model called Norn, that predicts what people will respond to, researched and built in house.

name: Shire Intelligence
line: Shire uses CCTV to run restaurants in real time.
about: Shire is an AI floor manager for full-service restaurants, running on the cameras they already have. It sees what a great manager sees: a guest ready to order, a table waiting on the check, a four-top that needs clearing, a server that is double booked. Then it acts, alerting staff in the moment and seating each new party with the server who has room. A POS only knows what gets typed into it. Shire knows what is happening in the room, so wait-time quotes, staffing, and pricing run on real turn times.

name: Silica
line: Actuators for Physical AI
about: Silica makes the first affordable actuators that sense forces directly, so that all robots can feel the world around them.

name: Latent
line: Stop AI agent mistakes by reading the model’s mind
about: Latent is a control layer for AI, built on interpretability. It reads signals inside a model as it works and checks every answer and agent action in milliseconds. Then it lets the output through, holds it, re-asks a stronger model, or sends it to review with the reason attached. Reading the model is far cheaper than running a second LLM, so it can check every step. Latent stops 99% of rule-breaking agents before they act, against 69% for a frontier LLM judge.

name: antimattr
line: voice-first hardware interface for human-agent interaction
about: antimattr is building the hardware interface for human–agent interaction: an AI wearable system made up of a smart ring and voice-isolating earbuds. Voice is the fastest way to instruct an AI agent, but most people won’t use it in public because it’s noisy and unreliable. We think voice AI adoption is held back by hardware, not by model quality. The earbuds use our proprietary voice isolation to capture your voice clearly anywhere, whether that’s a loud pub, a factory floor or a busy street. That means clear calls and dictation/transcription you can trust.

name: Synara
line: Building the next generation of AI enabled monitoring
about: Security cameras don’t stop crime. They film it. Traditional monitoring does one job: watching an empty site after hours. It misses anything more complex, and anything that happens during the day. When something does happen, it sends an alert and leaves the response to you. Synara is the AI monitoring station for the cameras that are already installed. It needs no new hardware and watches day and night. It understands far more than intruders: falls, guns, fights. And it owns the response.

name: Vyra
line: Personal video editing agent for shortform content
about: Instead of making users learn a timeline, we let them upload footage, describe what they want, and get back a polished edit in minutes.

name: Odin Robotics
line: Robot arms that do repetitive manual work in existing factories.
about: Odin Robotics deploys robot arms in small and mid-sized factories to do repetitive manual work, like machine tending and packing. They work alongside existing machines and people, so factories don't have to redesign their lines. With deterministic controls and learned skills, they're both reliable and flexible.

name: Preload
line: Sensorimotor context for physical AI
about: Designing and iterating a multimodal hardware stack (currently ego + tactile gloves + EMG) to collect rich and scalable datasets for physical AI. Also interested in how we can use this technology to advance surgery. Built by PhD founders (Johns Hopkins, Caltech) with world-class expertise in brain-computer interfaces (Neuralink, Meta, Paradromics)

name: Constor
line: AI native OS for the construction industry

name: Lux Foods
line: Crops engineered for premium fruit, grown without sunlight.
about: Lux Foods engineers ultra-compact plants that produce mostly fruit, then grows them on sugar with 90% less light. We design the biology and hardware together to make robotic farming easier. Starting with cherry tomatoes, we’re building year-round production of flavorful, nutritious, pesticide-free fruit near the people who eat it. Our tomatoes have been grown on the International Space Station, and now we're taking this technology to Earth.

name: Graphide
line: 10-20× faster CI runners + 24/7 agent cutting bloated CI bills 70+%
about: Graphide CI runs your CI 10-20× faster than GitHub runners on enterprise deployments, and our 24/7 agents optimize the CI itself, not just the machines. For teams with big CI bills that haven't been optimized, we cut costs 70%+ and take over the ongoing work of optimizing CI, so you can focus on your product. We're faster and cheaper because we own both the hardware and the optimizations and configs that run on it, which lets us do what owning only one could not.

name: Kanopy
line: Computer vision operating layer for physical infrastructure
about: Video to automatically identify risks and condition on power lines, pipelines, rail, and other types of infrastructure over hundreds of miles at once.

name: Dualizer
line: AI-powered physical simulation to design/optimize chemical processes
about: Dualizer builds AI-powered, physics-based process simulation and digital twins to design and scale chemical processes and optimize existing plants. We help engineering teams identify bottlenecks, increase yield and throughput, and reduce energy and production costs—improving plant efficiency and profitability. The platform combines AI reasoning, our proprietary deterministic simulation and optimization engine, and physics-informed machine learning. Engineers can build, calibrate, and refine models through conversation, starting from a diagram, available data, or an engineering objective.

name: Sutrix
line: Deployed AI to turn EHR data into study-ready datasets
about: Sutrix turns messy data from EHRs, clinical notes, wearables, and surveys into clean, study-ready datasets allowing healthcare research teams to deliver tailored patient care faster. Before a clinical study can start, research staff spend weeks pulling patient data from disconnected systems like the EHR, REDCap, and wearable platforms, reading notes chart by chart, and reconciling conflicting entries in spreadsheets.

name: OpEra
line: The AI decision engine for factories, warehouses and fleets
about: OpEra Technologies is the AI decision engine for factories, warehouses and fleets. Companies with physical operations make thousands of decisions every day, and we help their teams make the best one at every step from production to delivery: (1) Planning: how much to make, buy and stock. (2) Scheduling: what runs when, and who works on what. (3) Allocation: which warehouse or store gets each order. (4) Routing: boat, plane or truck, and which route each one takes. Founded out of MIT's Operations Research Center.

name: Papaya
line: Continuously improve the quality of your AI agents.
about: Papaya is the optimization engine for AI agents. Engineers don't have time to continually improve the agents they've shipped — the context bloat, overly chatty subagents, and broken tool calls sit in production traces nobody reads, quietly hurting agent efficiency. With Papaya they connect their agent directly via SDK, get actionable recommendations on how to improve quality, latency, and cost, and the ones they approve are pushed to production as pull requests. Papaya runs 200+ research-backed analyses across context, prompts, prompt caching, subagents, and tool calls.

name: Vouch
line: Personal wealth manager for 100M+ Indian professionals
about: Vouch is an AI-native wealth manager for India’s booming middle class. It makes investing and building wealth extremely simple for everyone: connect what you already own, share your goals, and Vouch takes care of the rest, from picking investments to cutting your tax bill. India will add $2.37 trillion in financial wealth by 2030, yet fewer than 1 in 10 Indians invest, and physical assets dominate. As the economy rapidly financializes, Vouch will be the one platform Indian professionals use to manage all their money.

name: Sinter
line: Accelerated plastics manufacturing
about: Sinter is a radically faster plastics pipeline, helping iteration heavy hardware teams evolve from prototypes to production parts on week-scale timelines.

name: Perit.AI
line: Expert-collected voice, egocentric and RL training data for frontier…
about: Perit is a training-data company for frontier AI labs. Everything we deliver is recorded, transcribed, labelled and graded by people who actually do the job: ex-contact-centre QA leads, claims handlers, ward clerks and shopkeepers, recruited for the sector and locale each program needs. What we deliver: - Voice and speech data: 4,000+ hours of audio delivered across 9 locales, transcribed verbatim and word-aligned, with 95%+ QA-sample accuracy.

name: ObsessionDB
line: Real-time data warehouse for agents
about: ObsessionDB is a real-time data warehouse that makes your data stack agent-ready. Your agents can ingest and query vast amounts of data in seconds, without the scary infra bill. Powered by our own more efficient fork of ClickHouse®.

name: Asim
line: Enable robots to operate safely in the real world.
about: Asim is building standardized benchmarks for physical intelligence, helping robotics companies understand their robots’ capabilities and safety limits before deployment. We test real robots under changing physical conditions, varying shape, weight, friction and material, to identify where performance breaks down and give engineers actionable feedback. Our four founders include three PhD researchers, two specializing in robotics, with backgrounds at Sony and NASA JPL and two RoboCup@Home championship wins.

name: UXDuck
line: Build better drones. Run better missions.
about: Starting with a modern interface for drones that users can build on and adapt. Works with planes, copters, rovers, boats and submarines. Try it in 5 seconds with simulated drones - https://uxduck.com/

name: Sona8
line: Voice agents survey employees to map, improve & automate workflows
about: Sona8 uses AI voice agents to interview employees about how work gets done. Consulting, transformation and corporate development teams use it to hear from more people and follow up after changes. Employees open a link and speak in their own language. The agent asks follow-up questions, and teams compare problems across sites and departments. We’ve completed 10,000+ employee interviews and signed one of the world’s top three consulting firms.

name: Index Law
line: Your company's AI lawyer
about: Index Law is building Mike-1, a superhuman AI lawyer*! Mike is an AI legal agent that gives every business the capabilities of a world-class legal team. Unlike traditional legal AI tools that help lawyers work faster, Mike gets legal work done directly for your business. It understands your business, reviews and negotiates contracts, handles corporate matters, and brings in vetted human lawyers when specialist expertise is needed. Your documents, agreements, signatures, and legal history live in one workspace. Mike remembers your business and becomes more useful with every matter.

name: Axonnic
line: Creating human skill at robot scale
about: Axonnic is building the missing data layer for dexterous robotics. Our wearable EMG technology captures human intent, effort and force directly from muscle activity as people demonstrate physical tasks. By revealing the physical signals that video cannot capture, Axonnic gives AI models the data they need to learn more precise and dexterous behaviour. Beyond robotics, this creates a foundation for new forms of human–computer interaction in which technology can understand and respond directly to human movement and intent.

name: Versine
line: Let your agents send and receive money. We're Venmo for agents.
about: Versine lets your agents send and receive money. We’re Venmo for agents. Connect it to ChatGPT, Claude, Muse or your own agent through our MCP. Then send your agent a dinner receipt and it splits the bill. Tell it “if I don’t run 10k tomorrow, pay Jake $10” and it checks Strava and pays out if you miss. It can also pay invoices that land in your inbox, or split rent and utilities with your roommates every month. Recipients don’t need an account: they get a link to cash out to their bank. Banking and payout services are provided by licensed partners.

name: Memorable

name: Melty
