name: RouterPlus
line: Marketplace for AI inference: the right model at the best price
about: RouterPlus is a marketplace for AI inference. We find the right AI model for a team's product, then get it served at the team's scale, at the best price. Most teams that run AI in production pay for a top model on every task, when a cheaper model can do most of the work. The same model can also cost twice as much depending on which provider runs it, and many providers fail at peak traffic. RouterPlus tests models on a team's own traffic and recommends one. Providers then compete for the workload.

name: Quippy
line: Helps build social skills through daily practice
about: Quippy is a daily practice app for your social life. You run short, realistic practice conversations, like pushing back on a boss or talking during a first date, and get line-by-line feedback on what landed and what backfired. The curriculum adapts to each person's patterns, reshaping itself around their weak spots, ensuring steady improvement in the conversations that matter most.

name: Composal
line: Always-on agents that keep working after engineers log off
about: Composal gives engineers always-on agents that work in the cloud, each with its own computer, Slack handle and memory. An engineer gives one a standing order, like “watch Sentry, fix new errors, get the fix reviewed and ship it,” and it keeps going after the laptop closes. Our QA agents test every pull request by using the app like a real user, and have found over 1,500 bugs in customers’ apps since mid-October.

name: Epsilab
line: Long horizon RL environments from real-life data
about: Applied AI research lab focused on RL for frontier model training. Our research and evals cover real-world environment simulation, long-horizon workflows, and multi-player agents, etc.

name: Verdun
line: The world's most advanced security monitoring service
about: Traditional security camera monitoring is vaporware. Your sites aren't actually being protected. A monitoring center's video alarm queue is managed by operators who are flooded by alarms during peak activity - meaning it often takes 20+ minutes for them to even see your alarm. When you call an airline and get placed on hold for a long time only for an offshore operator to tell you he can't solve your problems, this is the security equivalent.

name: Caveman
line: Caveman cuts what AI agents cost without making them dumber.
about: Caveman is the optimization stack for AI agents. It observes real agent workloads, finds cost and performance inefficiencies, tests improvements, and safely deploys the ones that work.

name: Acyclic Labs
line: Benchmarks, RL envs and infra for scaling agent swarms
about: We’re building the foundations of agent swarms that can materially accelerate all work: benchmarks to measure model capabilities, models trained to coordinate thousands of agents, RL environments to improve them, and infrastructure that can put a datacenter’s worth of compute behind a single conversation within seconds. Both founders graduated top 10% from Cambridge. Ram is a published ML researcher and Varun worked at the frontier of parallel programming languages and shipped enterprise multi-agent systems at Palantir and Tracelight.

name: Axiomat
line: We make AI that never hallucinates.
about: Axiomat makes it impossible for AI agents to make mistakes when querying a company’s data. It formally verifies that the agents’ queries are correct before employees or customers rely on the answers. It is becoming increasingly important for companies to rely on AI without the need for humans to manually check the answers. This has created a need for systems which can guarantee correctness without limiting the agent’s capabilities. Axiomat provides the infrastructure to prove that answers are correct, starting with data queries and analysis.

name: Tilion
line: Super fast, unblockable browser infra for agents
about: we build self-healing browser infrastructure that runs millions of agent operations a day without supervision. teams use it for large-scale data collection, agentic workflows, continuous monitoring, and anything else that requires acting on the web at volume.

name: Clean
line: Revenue intelligence for agents and sales teams.
about: Agents can run outreach on their own now. In manufacturing, insurance, defense and banking, buying runs on a clock. Every deal has a transaction window almost nobody can see. Reach out before it opens and nobody answers. After it closes, the deal's gone. Clean finds that window and gives agents and sales teams the strategy to win the deal. We're building the revenue intelligence every sales agent will run on.

name: Blinka
line: Banking for US companies operating globally
about: Blinka is banking for US companies operating globally. Our customers incorporate in the US but run their operations, teams, and vendors from other countries. They use Blinka as their primary operating account. With Blinka, companies can: - Open a USD business account without being in the US. - Send money abroad without the usual 4–5% FX fees. - Earn yield on treasuries. - Issue global corporate cards with 1.5% cash back and 0 international fees. - Manage their financial operations with our AI tools.

name: Rezora IO
line: Shopify for AI voice agents: home services live in 10 minutes
about: Rezora IO is an AI voice platform for real estate and home services that answers, qualifies, and schedules every lead, automatically filling your calendar while you focus on closing.
where: New York City, NY, USA; Remote

name: Volaren
line: The personal investing agent that comes to you
about: Volaren is the personal investing agent that comes to you. It knows why your portfolio moved, suggests your next idea, and trades it for you. Connect your bank accounts & brokerage and Volaren tells you what changed and why, answers any question about your money, and turns any idea into a trade. You can copy the moves of famous investors, politicians, proven strategies and themed baskets in a tap, or set up your own AI agents to watch the market and act within the limits you choose.

name: Spine
line: We run benefits, payroll & compliance for startups, for free
about: Spine runs benefits, payroll, and compliance for startups for free. We do the work by giving teams dedicated senior HR and benefits specialists who operate on top of their existing HRIS (Rippling, Deel, Gusto, ADP). We help companies find better-fit, more cost-effective health plans - reducing healthcare costs by around 15% on average - while running payroll, handling compliance, managing open enrollment, and supporting employees directly in Slack. 30+ startups already use Spine to lower healthcare costs and take hours of back-office work off their teams.

name: Elithia
line: Agents for the medical review behind every claim
about: US workers' compensation paid out $64.1 billion in 2023. Personal injury, malpractice, and other insurance claims add billions more. Behind every one of these claims sit thousands of pages of medical records, and a clinician spends hours or days reading them to reconstruct what happened to the patient. Elithia is building agents to do this work. Our agents reconstruct patient histories, reason across conflicting evidence, and produce defensible analyses, with every finding cited to the original record.

name: Terse
line: Durable state for AI agents
about: We build infrastructure to power agentic systems such as software factories, multiplayer agent frameworks and agent coordination.

name: The Subvocal Company
line: Glasses that turn silent speech into text
about: The Subvocal Company builds glasses that use radio-frequency sensing to turn silently mouthed words into text, replacing voice AI and keyboards as the next interface between humans and AI. Our launch on X reached 12M+ impressions and we've collected >$150k in preorder deposits from customers.

name: Frontrunner
line: Engineer your GTM
about: Frontrunner lets GTM teams describe the work they need done and deploy agents that run it, connected to their existing tools and data. Our customers are building agents for everything from inbound lead routing to signal-based outbound and multi-touch attribution. Think Cursor for GTM: the place to engineer your revenue factory. GTM engineers and rev ops teams spend their days stitching tools together; and fielding requests from sales and marketing. Each campaign has its own version of who the customer is, what makes a lead qualified, and which signals matter.

name: Decent
line: Your health plan should get better year-round. Not just once a year.
about: Decent is a health insurance brokerage for small businesses. We compare every way to cover your team, show what each one costs, and then keep improving your plan all year. We're paid by insurance companies, so we're free to you.

name: Theseus Robotics
line: Humanoids to restock retail shelves & pick orders
about: Theseus Robotics creates the OS & Physical AI to deploys humanoids to automate menial tasks in supermarkets. During the day, our robotics pick orders for e-grocery orders. Overnight, they restocks shelves with goods from the back warehouse.

name: Ascenix
line: Custom software for senior care facilities.
about: Ascenix is building one custom interface for running senior homes. We combine reusable building blocks into workflows tailored to each home's existing processes, from incident reporting to reimbursement. Homes get custom software without hiring an engineering team. Living in a retirement home convinced us that the best way to improve residents' lives is to improve the systems staff rely on. As the older population grows, care teams need more time and resources. Repetitive reporting, missed reimbursement, and compliance problems take those away.

name: GrayPass
line: Verify the expected person is still in control before sensitive…
about: Login tells you who signed in. GrayPass helps apps check who’s behind sensitive actions and whether they’re authorized before those actions go through. It combines identity, device and session context with behavioral signals like typing rhythm, cursor movement and scrolling. Before a sensitive action goes through, GrayPass evaluates that evidence against your team’s policy and returns a decision: allow, challenge, hold or deny. Your app enforces the decision. This applies to actions like exporting sensitive data, changing admin permissions or allowing an AI agent to act on someone’s behalf.

name: Cyclon
line: a phone where AI is the interface
about: Cyclon is rebuilding the phone around AI. Instead of opening apps and tapping through screens, you tell your phone what you want and it does it for you. With one touch, you can spin up AI agents to control your phone or handle tasks in the background. AI isn’t just inside an app - it’s the phone itself.

name: Ageospatial
line: Physical intelligence for every decision with Geospatial AI.
about: Ageospatial helps organizations value the risk on their physical assets (properties, land, infrastructure) remotely using satellite imagery. 97% of commercial properties are never physically inspected because it's too slow and expensive. So insurers price risk based on what the client or broker tells them, and about half the time at least one of those records is wrong. The result is mispricing, fraud, and an estimated $36B in premium leakage every year in the US alone, which gets exposed the moment a disaster hits.

name: HABU
line: Like Crosby, but for real estate development
about: HABU is an AI-native real estate development firm that helps real estate investors deploy capital to build housing faster, at lower cost, and with higher yield. We're building an internal AI-native operating system that completes 90%+ of development tasks at 95% faster processing speeds while delivering the same outcomes customers expect externally: high yield, low risk projects. We're selling the outcome, not the inputs to the outcome. Developers are service providers for white-collar investors: they find land, construct buildings, and operate and sell them for a profit.

name: The Agentic Data Co.
line: Training data for speech models
about: We design and collect audio datasets for training speech models.

name: BioDelivera
line: Programmable drug delivery precisely targets only diseased cells
about: BioDelivera has developed proprietary GCV™, a drug delivery platform designed to travel through the body and selectively target diseased cells while sparing healthy ones. GCVs can carry genetic medicines, DNA, RNA, small molecules, or combinations of these at the same time. BioDelivera has demonstrated efficacy in tumors, muscle, and brain and is expanding to additional tissues. The company’s mission is to enable cures for every patient, across every disease.

name: Redoubt Insurance
line: Commercial insurance for small businesses
about: Redoubt is a commercial insurance agency for small businesses. We believe our customers are our most important business partners, and they deserve our full attention. Machines can already handle the boring parts, the next step is to continually learn from experience.

name: Lark
line: AI agents that automate workflows for distributors
about: Lark deploys AI agents for distributors to automate purchasing, demand forecasting, inventory monitoring, sales operations, and data analysis. Our agents connect to the ERP, CRM, email, spreadsheets, and other software your team already uses. They forecast demand, prepare purchase orders, flag inventory issues, update sales records, and answer questions using your business data. Together, these agents can run a distributor’s entire operation.

name: Superserve
line: Virtual machines for long-running agents
about: Superserve gives every AI agent its own computer in the cloud. Each one is an isolated VM that starts in under 50ms, sleeps between turns, and picks up exactly where it left off, for hours, weeks or indefinitely. Traditional cloud infrastructure was built to run one app for many users. Agents flip that. Each agent needs its own isolated machine where it can write and run code, use tools and work on its own for long stretches. Everything it produces has to persist the whole time, the way your laptop keeps your work. That means agent computers have to be stateful, secure and cheap to run.

name: Canos
line: AI-powered blood test to detect cancer in dogs (and cats soon).
about: Canos is bringing a human-grade liquid biopsy platform for dogs, starting with a single blood draw. We sequence cell-free DNA to perform multi-modal analysis of fragmentation, copy number variation, native methylation (5mC and 5hmC) and more to detect cancer signals. Owners bank a healthy baseline for their dog and track changes every year. Dogs already diagnosed get personalized monitoring through treatment. We partner with mobile vets and vet clinics to serve SF and NYC. Our mission is to make pet cancer curable through early detection and monitoring.

name: Trepo
line: The agentic grocery shopper that knows what you have and need.
about: Trepo is building agents that shop for you, starting with groceries. To know what your household needs, a shopper has to understand what happens at home. Today, that information is scattered across cupboards, receipts, recipes, and the people living there, leaving one person to remember what’s running low, what needs using, and what’s for dinner. Our Kitchen Assistant and connected app help households track their food, decide what to cook, and use what they already have. A shared device lives in the kitchen, where groceries are unpacked, meals are prepared, and leftovers are saved.

name: Hundred
line: 100% automated inspection for precision hardware parts
about: Hundred is an automated inspection system for the components that make up devices like phones, smartwatches, and laptops. Hundred helps factories cut waste and prevent line-down issues by catching sub-100µm visual defects before parts reach the assembly line. Designs change so fast that traditional machine vision can't keep up, forcing factories to rely on manual inspection, literally people checking parts under microscopes to sort out bad parts. Human inspectors miss roughly 15% of defects, and a single bad part can turn a finished device into scrap.

name: Nines
line: Robot pit crew for AI data centers
about: Nines builds autonomous robots, and the models that run them, for data centers. The AI buildout is the biggest construction project of our lifetime, and the physical work inside it is still done by hand. Every GPU rack needs thousands of fiber connections matched, inserted, and verified before a hall goes live. After that, every building needs people on site around the clock to swap drives, transceivers, and fans. With our robots operators bring capacity online faster, with fewer errors and less downtime.

name: STASIS
line: The WHOOP for 16 billion eyes

name: Tilo
line: The Microsoft of the AI era: the operating system for AI agents.
about: Tilo gives AI agents one shared computer. Today every agent gets its own virtual machine and works by screenshots and clicks, which is slow, expensive and brittle. Agents that work together have to describe what they did to each other in messages. Tilo is a Linux-based operating system built for agents as users. Every app exports typed actions that agents call over MCP while people use the same actions as buttons, on the same live state. Many agents work in one workspace at once and read each other's work instead of messaging about it.

name: Kairos Health
line: AI front desk that fills every chair for dental practices
about: Kairos Health automates patient engagement for dentists by handling phones and insurance. Kairos plugs into a dental practice's software, calls patients who are overdue for care, and books them directly into the schedule. It also answers every inbound call 24/7 and verifies insurance. Our mission is to put practice operations on autopilot and keep every chair filled.

name: Kiwi
line: Kiwi is your GTM agent's favorite data engineer.
about: While engineering teams have become fully AI-native, GTM teams have fallen behind. Teams struggle with continuous enablement of their teams, keeping context, agent skills, and connectors up to date with shifting GTM states and strategies, as well as accuracy, when operators can't trust their agents because the data is incomplete, inconsistent, or unreliable. With Kiwi, every agent is self-improving, and cites the SQL query and data snapshot pulled from the Kiwi GTM brain used to produce every output. Kiwi enables GTM teams to be fully AI-native.

name: OpenHack
line: Always-on AI security engineer
about: OpenHack is an always on AI Security Engineer. OpenHack understands your business, system design and developer intent like a real security engineer. It ingests all this context to find the hardest vulnerabilities through AI codebase scanning, AI pentesting and Supply Chain Security. It verifies and prioritizes vulnerabilities automatically, and filters out false positives like a real security engineer drastically reducing overhead.

name: Aucert
line: A team of expert AI agents that test mobile apps on their own.
about: Top apps need weeks and multiple teams to test every release. Aucert does it in hours, and plugs into agentic coding workflows so issues get fixed in the same loop. Agents: Functional QA · Accessibility · Google Play Policy · App Store Policy Next: Performance · Security. DM if you need either.

name: Mnemonic Labs
line: OpenAI for Financial Markets
about: Mnemonic Labs (YC F26) is a neolab founded by two brothers who are Olympiad finalists and MIT graduates; Kalki made $20M in annual PnL at 22 at Tower and Videh was the youngest quant at Citadel at 19. Just as LLMs and scaling laws quickly dominated all other NLP approaches, we're building world models that will dominate both human and machine traders.

name: Sintropix
line: AI-native ERP that closes your books and files your taxes
about: Sintropix is a financial system of record that closes your books every day and files your taxes in every country you operate in. We connect to your banks, invoicing and payroll, and handle the accounting end-to-end. Founders get one place to do their finance work: track KPIs, see consolidated P&L and ARR reports, and forecast runway.

name: Phone Harness
line: Let your agent control your phone
about: Phone Harness is the most popular open-source harness for phone automation with 3,800+ GitHub stars. We enable agents to tap, type, and scroll on your personal phone or cloud-hosted phones. Supports iPhone and Android. No jailbreak, API, or app installation needed.

name: Adside.ai
line: AI agency that manages paid ads on Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.
about: We're Robin Choy and Guillaume Miara, founders of Adside (adside.ai). We're building Adside, a swarm of agents that manages ads on Meta, Google and LinkedIn, etc. We’re building the service we wished we had in our previous B2B marketing software company that we sold earlier this year.

name: RATLOG
line: Reusable heavy-lift rockets

name: Proto
line: The product designer's coding agent
about: Designers are no longer drawers, but builders. Yet their canvas based design tools are still built for drawing, and the coding agents they’re using are built for engineers. Proto is a coding agent with all the capabilities of Claude Code, but rebuilt from scratch for designers, with features like Midjourney’s rapid idea exploration, and Figma’s first class sharing.

name: Maritime
line: The managed cloud for AI agents.
about: Maritime is a fully managed cloud platform for startups selling AI agents. We help them run thousands of agents, each in its own isolated, persistent computer, starting at $1 per agent per month, with all underlying infrastructure, scaling, sleep/wake, and monitoring handled automatically.

name: Super Powers Mobility (SPM)
line: The highest performance modular battery packs for mobility/vehicles
about: We started off building the highest performance, 470 volt electric off-road vehicles but we realized our ultra power dense battery packs are useful for mobile and stationary energy storage and power export, for military and consumer use cases. We develop battery packs, power electronics, and traction powertrain systems for vehicles. For the majority of 2026 we were marketing our electric off-road vehicles, but we pivoted to selling our high performance battery packs and power export capabilities in the month of September.

name: DeepMark
line: A live watermark inside AI voice that survives phone calls
about: DeepMark is the authentication layer for AI voice. When an AI agent speaks, we embed a compact, machine-readable ID directly into the audio, not in metadata, which gets stripped the moment a file is touched. The ID resolves to a trust record, so a bank, a call center, or the person on the line can verify in real time who the agent is.

name: Wondersearch
line: Instant semantic search over your data without embeddings.
about: Our mission is to give every AI agent the right context, from any amount of data. WonderSearch is search built for AI agents. We let developers make all of their data searchable by meaning, without embeddings, servers or ingestion, so agents can pull the right context and cite where it came from. Unlike vector databases and RAG stacks, there's no pipeline to build or maintain: connect your files and data, and they're searchable right away. It runs on our own search model, and you pay only per query, whatever the size of your data.

name: Plyxl
line: The workspace that does the work
about: Plyxl is the workspace that molds to your business. It builds apps, creates automations, and works across your entire company.

name: Boxes.dev
line: A better place to run your coding agents.
about: Close your laptop again. Run Claude Code and Codex on unlimited parallel cloud computers from your laptop, phone, and terminal. Bring your own subscription, start agents from Slack and Linear, and manage an agent swarm by letting your agents coordinate their work.

name: Jinko
line: Travel Search & Booking Infrastructure for AI agents

name: Mantle
line: The pit crew for machines and robots.
about: Mantle is a full-stack field service company that deploys, fixes and maintains machines for the companies that build them. We're not a marketplace or software tool, we own uptime directly to provide better, more reliable service without burdening your engineers on support calls. $500B+ a year is spent to keep machines running in the US, we're coming for all of it.

name: Cesara
line: Faster & accurate transactions for health systems

name: Keres
line: Kill the drone, keep the jet. Reusable unmanned interceptors.
about: Keres (KAIR-eez) builds reusable unmanned jet interceptors for air defense. The Garmur launches on cue, closes at jet speed, positively identifies and kills drones and cruise missiles, then lands to fly again. It gives commanders a fighter-class response at a fraction of the cost.

name: Aikido Technologies
line: Clean marine AI datacenters
about: We're building GW-scale datacenters in the ocean where there are no limits to the speed and scale of deployment. Our proprietary offshore platform structure supports a 15MW+ wind turbine, hours of battery storage, backup diesel power generation and 10+ MW of data halls inside their structure, which can be cooled freely by the ocean.

name: Spacesheep
line: Documents of the future: the collaboration surface for people and…
about: Agents now write faster than anyone can read. Spacesheep is where their work lands: any agent turns a session's output into a space that your team takes in at a glance. It works with the agents you already use, and has its own agent built in. Teams work on it together: comment on the exact spot, @mention a teammate, or ask @spacesheep and an agent makes the change live on every screen. Every change is a version, and every space is searchable by meaning, for people and agents alike. Spaces can show live data streamed from servers and sensors, and connect to the tools your team already uses.

name: Godpack
line: The marketplace for internet culture.

name: ChampionEffect Inc.
line: An AI coach for every employee!
about: ChampionEffect is an AI Coach that teaches AI to every employee at a company, in Slack and Teams. The Coach helps with a new AI concept, a new workflow, or any tool. It jumps on a call and walks you through the work, just like a coworker would. It points to the top use cases in your industry and tailors everything to your company’s needs and tools. Every time someone does a walkthrough with the Coach, it learns how real work gets done at the company and uses that knowledge with other coworkers.

name: Nuum Robotics
line: Snake-like robots for maintenance inside machinery.

name: GatherHQ
line: Applied AI for Enterprise GTM (3X founders, 10X growth, backed by ANT)
about: Gather's long horizon agent serves enterprise GTM teams by continually interviewing real buyers and turning what it learned into content that drives pipeline and simulations that predict customer behavior. More than 65 enterprise marketing teams, including Envoy, Eclypsium, Cover Genius, Fortinet, CoStar, Bagel Brands, and Family Express, use Gather to continually fight AI slop and create original on-brand, third-party validated thought leadership, reports, ebooks, and campaign content. The value of that research compounds.

name: Tesser
line: Seamless cloud dev environments
about: Tesser is a cloud development runtime that lets developers run multiple dev environments in parallel without overloading their laptops. Our CLI moves workloads like servers, builds, tests, and typechecking to isolated cloud machines while developers continue using their existing editors and coding agents. Tesser handles provisioning, networking, and port forwarding. Teams can access each other's environments through our gateway, share live previews, and run Tesser on our infrastructure or their own cloud (BYOC).

name: Colony
line: Long-range drone network for world data collection

name: Xulux
line: Prepare your devtool for agents
about: Xulux helps Devtool companies increase their user conversion. Problem: Companies lose customers to failed agent implementations Solution: We proactively create evals and benchmarks to find out why agents drop your tools and fix them automatically. Our evals keeps up with the changes and generate evolving tests forever. And we run these evals across models and harnesses.

name: DataNode
line: Structured products on prediction markets
about: DataNode is building the structuring data layer for event risk. Our engine combines prediction markets with traditional derivatives to quantify and risk assess any event exposure and build a priced, tailored hedge, even before a market for it exists.

name: Vibe Robotics
line: Robotics workforce for hotels
about: Vibe Robotics builds robots for the work nobody should have to repeat. Every day in every hotel, towels go up to rooms, linens move between floors, and stacks of laundry need to be folded before the next guests arrive. It’s hard, physical, and hotels can’t hire enough people to do it. Vibe 01 is built for exactly that. It carries, delivers and folds. Two arms, a lift column, and a camera head on a base that drives itself through back-of-house hallways and service elevators. It learns by watching people do the job, then does it on its own.

name: Render
line: AI CMO that puts marketing on autopilot
about: Render is an AI CMO that runs a business's marketing on autopilot. We're at $1.7M ARR, growing 100% month over month, with 1,000+ paying businesses. Render makes the ads, launches the campaigns, and improves them every day. It covers Meta, Google and YouTube ads, cold email, direct mail, and TV commercials. Most small businesses can't afford a marketing team, and agencies charge thousands a month to run one or two channels. Render runs all of them for a fraction of the price. Owners connect their accounts and set a budget, and Render does the rest.
